info.title: Tilo API
info.description: Every resource of a Tilo workspace, its fields and its actions, over HTTP: docs/developers/api.md says how. Each app's actions take the arguments and answer the result its surface declares: `x-tilo-actions` lists them, each naming its arguments' schema.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The API itself, and the key's account: the person's workspaces and keys

tags.name: Resources

tags.name: Invocations

tags.name: Events
tags.description: What changes in a workspace, as it changes

tags.name: Models

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: A workspace's events posted to a URL

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Bytes going into a workspace and coming out of it

tags.name: Programs
tags.description: Several calls as one step, written in tilolang

Error.description: Every refusal, whatever route it came from.

code.description: Stable and typed: what a program branches on.

next_steps.description: Calls that would work, each a sentence.

retry_after_ms.description: How long to wait before the same call works.

revoked_at_ms.description: When the key was revoked, for `key_revoked`.

action.description: The action refused, with what it takes, for an action's refusal.

kind.description: `read`, `undoable` or `outside`: what running it may reach.

result.description: The JSON schema of what it answers, where it declares one.

schema.description: The JSON schema of the value, where the app gives one.

Param.description: One parameter of an action, as its app publishes it.

key.description: What the key sent reaches, when one was sent.

scope.description: `all` or the one workspace it reaches.

created_by.description: The person's device that approved it.

expires_at_ms.description: `null` for a key that lasts until revoked.

id.description: What every route names it by.

host.description:
The host that keeps it: a server's name, or the person's device that
hosts it; absent while none of their devices said.

role.description: `owner` for one of the person's own, else the role they hold there.

labels.description:
What the person labelled it with when they made it (`customer_id` →
`cus_8121`), read by their own keys alone.

unattended.description:
Keys made for this workspace alone run commands in its Linux machine
without asking the person each time; absent while they are asked, as
every workspace starts. Read by the owner's keys alone.

own.description: One of the person's own, rather than one they were invited into.

kept_here.description: Whether the device answering keeps a copy of it.

Workspace.description:
A workspace as the account lists it: what `/v1` answers, and what an MCP
client and the desktop read of the person's workspaces.

path.description: The path listed; `apps` for the apps.

actions.description: The actions of the resource listed.

kinds.description:
The actions the rows offer, once for each kind of row: a row names
those it offers by id.

next_cursor.description: Passed back as `cursor` for the rest.

id.description: The resource's own id, which names it whatever else is titled the same.

key.description: The app's stable key for it, the name its actions answer it by.

kind.description: The app's type of it, or `app`.

has_children.description:
Whether a query with this row as its parent answers rows the workspace
holds now. An app holding no document here says no, though listing it
would start it on a new one; a walk reads what is there and starts
nothing.

reads.description:
Whether a read answers the row as a resource of its own. A row that is
only a place inside it (an option or a choice, like a reading font or a
built-in folder) is part of what lists it and is never read alone; a
listing that does not say is read as it always was, every row read.

actions.description:
The ids of the actions it offers, each described once in the
listing's `kinds` under the row's `kind`.

Row.description: One row of a listing: a resource under the path listed, or an app.

fields.description: The app's own fields, with its own types.

cursor.description: The app's cursor for the next page.

surface.description:
For an app: its surface in the form it is kept by
(`collab_types::surface::canonical`), what types are generated from.

surface_version.description: For an app: its surface's version, `<app>@<digest>`.

item.description: The key a read takes it by.

Child.description: A list of what a resource holds, one entry of it.

status.description: `ok`, `pending` or `cancelled`. (A failure is the error shape.)

path.description: The action at the resource it resolved to, `app/resource#action`.

result.description: The action's output, as the app typed it.

made.description:
What it made, each with its id and the address it is published under:
every item a write of several made, not only the first.

link.description: The link to the record it changed.

links.description: Every record it changed, once each.

edited_by_person.description: What actually ran, when the person changed the arguments first.

ask.description: What the person is being asked, while it waits for them.

undone.description: What was undone, for an undo.

ActionAnswer.description: An action's answer, and an invocation's.

Made.description: An item a write made: its id, and the address it is published under.

url.description: Where the person answers it, when a page for it exists.

Ask.description: What the person is asked before an action runs.

text.description:
The lines, in reading order, one node each:
`<role> "<name>" = "<value>" [state]`, indented by depth.

app.description: The app whose window shows it.

shown.description: Whether the lines are of the resource or of the window it could not show.

tree.description: The same view as a tree: each node's role, name, value, state, bounds and action.

viewport.description: The view's size, in logical pixels.

window_origin.description: Where the view stands in the app's window, in logical pixels.

revision.description: The revision of the document the view shows.

picture.description: Where the picture is kept, as a content address, when one was asked for.

View.description:
What an app's window shows for a resource: its view's semantic lines, the
same ones an MCP client's `tilo_view` prints, and a picture with `picture`.

session.description:
The program session it continues, as an earlier answer named it: the
`let`s its programs bound, the references its answers showed (`n3`),
and the steps `undo` and `history task` take back and list. Without
it the program starts a new session.

status.description:
`ok`, `waiting` (for its person's yes: `text` names where they answer, and it runs
once they approve) or `failed`.

output.description: The program's answer, a line per element.

detail.description: Why it failed: the trap's words, or what did not compile.

steps.description: Every step of the run that changed something, oldest first.

text.description:
What a person reads: the answer's lines, each resource by its
reference (`n3`).

session.description:
The program session it ran in: send it with the next program to
continue it.

size.description: How many bytes the whole file is.

offset.description: How many of them are there: the next piece goes at this offset.

PutContent.description:
A content put: where an unfinished one stands, and what every byte of it
is once the last piece answered.

id.description: The cursor after it: `Last-Event-ID` resumes there.

data.description: The event as its kind gives it.

Event.description: One event of a workspace's stream, or of a webhook's delivery.

messages.description:
The conversation: each `{"role", "content"}`, the role `system`,
`user`, `assistant` or `tool`.

tools.description:
The tools the model may call, each `{"name", "description",
"input_schema"}`.

max_output_tokens.description: The most tokens the answer may take.

ModelAsk.description:
One turn asked of the person's own model, which the server that keeps
their workspace asks with the key their vault keeps there: the
conversation as the model service takes it. The answer streams as
server-sent events: `text` and `reasoning` each carry `{"text": …}`, what
the model wrote since the event before; `answer` ends the stream with the
whole turn, `{"Ok": {"message", "stop_reason", "usage"}}` or
`{"Err": {"kind", "message"}}`, the kind telling a caller what to do
(`no_provider`: none set up yet; `authentication`: no key kept); `error`
ends it with a refusal of the API's own shape.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.new_requ.description: Starts a blank request in the builder, leaving the one it held.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.new_coll.description: Creates a collection to keep requests in.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.delete_c.description: Deletes a collection and the requests saved in it.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.save_req.description: Saves the request in the builder into a collection.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.open_req.description: Opens a saved request in the builder.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.rename_d.description: Renames the request in the builder.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.delete_o.description: Deletes the saved request the builder holds a copy of.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.new_envi.description: Creates an environment and starts using it.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.delete_e.description: Deletes an environment and the variables it held.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.use_envi.description: Switches the environment whose variables fill what is sent.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.no_envir.description: Sends with no environment: every `{{variable}}` stays as typed.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.keep_cre.description:
Keeps the value typed for the request's sign-in where the workspace cannot read it, and
remembers only the reference.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.set_sche.description: Changes the scheme, taking the credential of the one before off this device.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.forget_c.description: Takes the request's sign-in off this device.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.send.Arg.description:
Sends what the builder holds to the address it names, in the environment in use, and answers
the response the engine wrote: its status, status text, headers, size and body. An agent or a
script calling `send` reads the answer in this one call instead of following a job.

A person at the window sends with `start_send` instead, which starts the same request as a
job they can stop while it waits: this action holds its caller until the answer arrives, so
there is nothing to cancel, which is why the window never calls it for its Send control.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.start_se.description:
Starts what `send` sends as a job the person at the window can stop, and leaves its answer to
`trigger watch_send`. A person pressing Send must be able to stop waiting, which an action
that waits for the answer cannot do; a caller that needs the answer in the call uses `send`.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.send_fai.description: Ends a send that got no answer from the engine, saying why in the window.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.settle_s.description:
Folds what a send's job said of itself into the window, and answers the response the job
brought when it came back with one.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.cancel_s.description: Stops waiting for the service to answer.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.poll_sen.description: Asks the device how the request on its way is doing, and keeps what it answered.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.open_sen.description: Opens a request that was sent before, with what it held when it went out.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.save_sen.description: Saves a sent request as a request in a collection, named by its route unless it had a name.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.copy_bod.description: Copies the response body, exactly as the response pane shows it.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.copy_hea.description: Copies every response header, one `Name: value` per line.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.copy_req.description: Copies the request as authored, with its `{{variables}}` and never a credential.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.dismiss_.description: Dismisses the line under the response.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.keep_ans.description: Keeps the answer in the workspace, so the window and an agent read the same one.

tl.so.tilo.api-tester.Workspace.record_s.description: Adds the request that just came back to the workspace's history, newest first.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.begin_restore.description: Starts finding the folder a restore writes into, without running anything yet.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.restore_now.A.description: Restores the snapshot into the folder the person chose.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.stop_work.Arg.description: Stops the work under way; what it was writing goes.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.poll.Argument.description: Asks the device how the work is doing, once a second while it runs.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.open_snapshot.description: Shows one snapshot's sheet: what it holds and what can be done with it.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.set_order.Arg.description: Lists the timeline newest first, or oldest first.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.show_place.Ar.description: Shows one of the sidebar's places.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.keep_more.Arg.description: Keeps one more snapshot of a class.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.keep_fewer.Ar.description: Keeps one fewer snapshot of a class.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.dismiss.Argum.description: Dismisses the line under the list.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.choose_source.description: Asks the person which folder this device protects.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.choose_destin.description: Asks the person where the snapshots go.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.go.Arguments.description: Walks the picker to another folder and shows the folders in it.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.go_up.Argumen.description: Walks the picker up one folder.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.pick.Argument.description:
Takes the folder the picker shows: as what this device protects, where snapshots go, or
where a restore writes.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.cancel_pick.A.description: Leaves the picker without changing anything.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.read_picker.A.description: Reads the folders of the one the picker shows.

tl.so.tilo.backups.Backups.start_work.Ar.description: Starts a piece of work and keeps the job the device gave it.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_page.Argume.description:
What the page of `p` says and does, carried to the window that holds it. Each action answers
the page's own report as an [`Answer`], and what was done is written into the page's record.

Read the page: what it says, line by line, as an agent reads it. A long page is read in
parts: a read that stops short names the line to read on from.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_page_change.description:
What changed on the page since the last read: the lines added and removed, or the whole
outline when the document is new.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_page_elemen.description: What a click at a point would hit, through overlays and banners, and the element holding it.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.wait_page_settle.description:
Wait for the page to go quiet, or until the words it must say are there and the ones it must
not say are gone.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_page_consol.description: The page's console messages and uncaught errors after a sequence number.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_page_networ.description:
The page's network requests after a sequence number: method, address, type, status and
failure, never headers, bodies or cookies.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_page_record.description: The record of who did what in the page, after the place `since` names.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_page_fields.description: Every field of the document with what it holds and who set it. A secret is listed by length.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_page_forms..description:
The document's forms as what they ask: their questions, the answers they offer, which are
required, and the buttons that send them.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_page_table..description: The page's tables as rows, a long one read in parts.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.find_page_text.A.description: The outline lines that hold `text`, each with its line number.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.find_page_elemen.description: The element the role and name name, and the ref that acts there.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.click_page.Argum.description: Press the element, as a hand does.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.hover_page.Argum.description: Move the pointer over an element, or to a point of the page.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.drag_page.Argume.description: Drag from one element or point to another, in steps.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.fill_page_secret.description: Write a secret into a password or card field: it is never kept in the page's record.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.fill_page_files..description: Choose the files of a file input, by absolute path.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.press_page.Argum.description: Press a key in the page, as `Control+a` or `Enter`.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.submit_page.Argu.description: Send the element's form through the page's own validation.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.open_from_page.A.description:
Keeps a page the page opened in a window of its own as a page of this browser, as its window
hands it over: a popup a site sized, or a plain new tab.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.remember_history.description:
Writes the pages the page can go to one way into its record, as its window hands them over:
what the menu then offers beside Back and Forward.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.fill_page_form.A.description:
Answers a whole form of the page in one ask: each question's answer by its name, through the
page's own validation, and the form's first button when `submit` is on. A form is named by
the shape `read_page_forms` publishes for it.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.pointer_page.Arg.description:
A trusted pointer gesture: press at the first point, move through the rest and release at
the last, for drawing on canvases.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.scroll_page.Argu.description: Turn the page's wheel to the top or the bottom, into view, or by a distance.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.capture_page.Arg.description: A picture of the page, or of one element's box, as a PNG.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.navigate.Argumen.description:
Open an address in the page's own window: a site named without its scheme opens as one
(`example.org`), and words that name no address open the search engine's answer to them.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.submit_address.A.description:
What Enter in the address does: what follows an extension's keyword goes to the extension,
which hears of it and goes where it sends the page; anything else is an address to go to.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.choose_omnibox.A.description: The person chose one of the rows under the address: the extension hears what it stands for.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.back.Arguments.description: Go back to the page before this one.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.forward.Argument.description: Go forward to the page this one followed.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.leave_fullscreen.description:
Leave the page's fullscreen: the engine stops presenting the page, and its window shows the
page with its own controls again at once, since the person pressed the way out. The engine's
own report of it follows into the record.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.remember_fullscr.description:
Writes whether the page is in fullscreen into its record, as its window hands it over: a
video or a slide deck that filled the screen, or left it.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.reader.Arguments.description: Show the page's article without its clutter.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.zoom.Arguments.description: Show the page at `level` zoom, where 1 is actual size.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.find_in_page.Arg.description:
Find words in the page: the window's search is the page's find, and the words are kept so
the way on to the next match and back to the previous ask for the same ones. No words takes
the find away: the marks go, and the page is left as it was before they were typed.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.answer_page_dial.description: Answer a page's own question: an alert, a confirmation or a prompt.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.refresh_page.Arg.description:
Reads what the page waits on into its window's record: the question it asks, the menu it
showed, and how far it has loaded. The window calls it when it opens the page and after each
answer; nothing here asks the page anything of its own.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.allow_permission.description:
Lets a site use what it asked for (its camera, microphone, location, notifications). The
window raises it as the Browser's own call when the site asks: the person allows it on the
system's card, which names the Browser and the site, and an always-allow lets this site have it
from then on. Declined, or the page gone, the site is told no.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.save_download.Ar.description:
Saves the file a page offers. The window raises it as the Browser's own call when the page
offers one, and the person allows it on the system's card.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.discard_download.description: Turns down the file a page offers: nothing is saved, and the page is told so.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.download.Argumen.description:
Downloads what an address serves into the person's Downloads, as a job of the Browser's own
that goes on when the window closes. A page's window raises it for a download the person
saved there, naming the handle its request waits under; a person or agent names an address.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.developer_tools..description: Opens the engine's developer tools for this page: its console, its elements and its network.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.print_page.Argum.description:
Writes the page as a PDF and hands it to Print Centre, where the person chooses the printer
and how it prints. The engine answers with the file once it has written it; a page with
nothing open has nothing to print.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.note_print.Argum.description:
Hands the PDF the engine wrote to Print Centre, through its own action, so the person
chooses the printer and how it prints there; the copy the engine wrote goes. The window
raises it once the engine is done; a person, agent or script never does.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.mute.Arguments.description: Silences the page's sound, or lets it play again.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.float_page_video.description:
Floats the page's video above its window as picture-in-picture, so it plays while the person
works elsewhere, or puts it back where the page draws it.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_back_histor.description:
Asks the page where it can go back to. The engine answers with the pages before this one,
which the page's record holds once its window reads them again.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_forward_his.description: Asks the page where it can go forward to, the answer kept like [`read_back_history`]'s.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.go_history_entry.description: Goes to one page of the page's own history, by the entry its reading named.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.read_site.Argume.description:
Reads the site's connection, its certificate, the requests tracker protection blocked and
what the site may ask for, into the page's record.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.clear_site_data..description:
Clears this site's storage, cookies and remembered forms, including cookies it shares with
its subdomains, and reloads it.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.block_site_permi.description: Blocks what the site may ask for (its camera, microphone, location and notifications).

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.ask_site_permiss.description: Lets the site ask again for what it was refused.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.discover_logins..description: Reads the login forms this page asks for.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.list_saved_login.description: Lists the logins the workspace's vault keeps for this site, by name.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.capture_login.Ar.description:
Takes what the person typed into a login form, so it can be saved for this site. The password
stays in the engine until saving hands it to the vault, and never crosses to the app.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.save_login.Argum.description:
Saves the capture the engine took in the workspace's vault, as a login of this site the Browser
keeps.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.fill_saved_login.description:
Fills a form of this page with a login the vault keeps for this site. A login the Browser saved
itself fills at once; any other is filled once its person allowed the Browser that one login.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.update_saved_log.description: Replaces a login the vault keeps with the capture the engine took.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.delete_saved_log.description: Forgets a login of this site from the vault: one the Browser saved, or one it may fill.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.cancel_login.Arg.description: Turns down the login the engine offers to save.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.discover_address.description: Reads the addresses the engine fills forms with.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.fill_saved_addre.description: Fills a form of this page with a saved address, through the engine.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.list_extensions..description: Reads the extensions installed on this device into the Browser's record.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.install_extensio.description:
Installs the extension package the person chose, a .crx signed by its publisher or a plain
.zip: the engine verifies a signed package, unpacks it under its own identifier, and lists
it. The person picks the package with the system's own chooser, as any app's file.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.install_store_ex.description:
Installs the Chrome Web Store's item `said` (a store page's address, or the extension's id):
its package comes from the store's update service, is verified, and is turned on as the
store installs one.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.update_extension.description:
Asks the Chrome Web Store for newer versions of the store extensions installed here and
installs them: they are there the next time a page opens, and are loaded now.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.enable_extension.description:
Turns an installed extension on, or off, in the running window: Chromium loads and unloads
it where the page stands, so nothing waits for a window restart.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.remove_extension.description: Forgets an extension installed on this device: its folder and everything it may do.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.click_extension..description:
Presses one of the page's extension buttons: the engine runs the extension's action, or opens
the page it offers.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.choose_extension.description: Presses one of the buttons a notification an extension showed offers.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.dismiss_extensio.description: Takes a notification an extension showed away without pressing anything.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.remember_extensi.description:
Writes the extensions a page's window listed into the Browser's record. The window raises it;
a person, agent or script never does.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.note_extension.A.description:
Writes what installing, turning on or removing an extension came to, in the person's words.
The window raises it; a person, agent or script never does.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.open_side_panel..description:
Asks the extension for its side panel beside the page: its own page says what the panel shows,
and the page's window shows it there.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.close_panel.Argu.description:
Closes the extension's page the page's window showed beside or over this one: its side panel,
or the page it asked the person to sign in on, which ends as turned down.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.remember_panel.A.description:
Writes the extension's page the page's window shows beside this one into its record, or takes
it away. The window raises it; a person, agent or script never does.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.remember_omnibox.description:
Writes the extension the address addresses, and the rows it offers, into the page's record; an
empty identifier takes them away, since the address no longer addresses one. The window
raises it; a person, agent or script never does.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.typed_address.Ar.description:
What the person typed in the page's address: when it starts with an extension's keyword and a
space, what follows is the extension's, which hears of each change.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.address_left.Arg.description: The person left the address without Enter: the extension hears of it.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.enter_omnibox.Ar.description: The person pressed Enter, or chose one of the rows: the extension hears what it was given.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.note_extension_u.description:
Writes what asking the Chrome Web Store for newer versions came to, in the person's words.
The window raises it; a person, agent or script never does.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.remember_credent.description:
Writes what a login action came to into the page's record: the forms the engine found, the
vault's logins for the site, the capture the engine took, and their own words. The window
raises it; a person, agent or script never does.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.sync_site_except.description:
Tells the engine which sites tracker protection is off for, as the Browser's own set says:
the engine keeps the same list beside its filters.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.allow_extension_.description:
Gives an extension the more access it asked for. The window raises it as the Browser's own
call, and the person allows it on the system's card, which says what the extension could then
do.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.sign_in.Argument.description:
Signs in to a site that asks for a user name and a password. The window raises it as the
Browser's own call; the person types both on the system's card, on this device, and the
password goes to the site alone: never into this action's arguments, its record or history.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.cancel_sign_in.A.description: Turns down a site's sign-in: nothing is sent, and the server shows its own page instead.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.let_leave.Argume.description:
Lets what the page sends leave it: a form, a navigation or a request kept until the person
says so. The window raises it as the Browser's own call, and the person allows it on the
system's card, which says what leaves and where.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.context_menu_act.description: Takes a row of the page's own menu, by the command the engine gave it.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.fill_address.Arg.description:
Fills a form of the page with a saved address, question by question, without sending it. The
form is named by the shape its reading publishes (`RememberedForm.signature`, or the
signature `read_page_forms` answers), and the page's own validation still decides whether it
could be sent.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.went_to.Argument.description:
The page went somewhere: where it is now is written on the page, and the visit joins the
person's history unless the page's window paused it.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.toggle_pause.Arg.description: Pauses or resumes the person's history in a page's window.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Page.ask_page.Argumen.description:
The page `p` does what `request` (JSON, as the window's page reads it) says, and answers the
page's own report. What was done is written into the page's record; a call that could not be
made answers with its words. Every named page action below is this one, written out.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.new_page.Argu.description:
Opens a page in a window of its own. Every window of the app is one page; what it shows, its
address and its own back and forward are the system's.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.new_private_p.description:
Opens a window that browses privately: nothing it reads, signs in to or downloads joins what
this device keeps of the person.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.go.Arguments.description:
Opens an address in a page of its own, or asks the search engine for what was typed when it
is not one.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.open_link.Arg.description:
Opens a link of a scheme this browser claims: the address in a page of its own, or the search
a `web+search:` link asks for. A shell hands a link here whether or not a window of the app is
open, and what this returns opens in the window.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.bookmark.Argu.description:
Saves a page for later. A page is bookmarked by its address alone: bookmarking it twice keeps
one bookmark, and no title given falls back to the address.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.set_site_prot.description:
Turns tracker protection off for one site, or back on. A site is named by its origin, so
turning it off for `https://example.org` covers every page of it.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.toggle_site_p.description: Turns tracker protection off for this site, or back on, as the page's shield does.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.forget_site_f.description: Forgets every form a site asked.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.forget_all_fo.description: Forgets every form every site asked.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.remember_form.description:
Remembers what a page's forms ask, as its window reads them: the shape of each form and of its
questions, never what a field held. A form read here already is read again: what it asks now
replaces what it asked before. `questions` is one question a line, its fields a tab apart:
name, the kind of answer, the label, `true` when it must be answered, and the answers it
offers, a `|` between them.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.add_address.A.description: Adds an address for the forms the person fills.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.clear_history.description: Clears the browsing history. Bookmarks and remembered forms stay.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.visit.Argumen.description:
Adds a page a window opened to the person's history, counting it when it is there already.
A page that opens itself is a visit like any other.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.trim_history..description:
Keeps the person's own visits to their newest `most`, forgetting the oldest: the history stays
within what a person could read, as every other list the system keeps does.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.arrived_at.Ar.description: Takes in a page a window arrived at: it joins the person's history.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.import_browsi.description:
Takes in the browsing data another browser holds, from the bundle this app's own import and
`tilo migrate` hand over: its history, its bookmarks, or both.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.import_histor.description:
Imports the pages another browser's history holds, from the bundle this app's own import and
`tilo migrate` hand over: a JSON text of `{"browser": "...", "visits": [{"url": "...",
"title": "...", "last": 1760000000, "count": 1}]}`. Importing the same bundle twice keeps one
set of pages.

tl.so.tilo.browser.Browser.import_bookma.description:
Imports the bookmarks another browser holds, from the bundle this app's own import hands
over: the `ImportBundle` JSON with bookmark chunks (`{"bookmarks": [{"url": "...",
"title": "...", "folder": "Work"}]}`). Importing the same file twice keeps one bookmark of
each page.

tl.so.tilo.browser.cancel_all_downloads..description: Stops every download still going, from every window.

tl.so.tilo.browser.open_download.Argumen.description: Opens a saved download in the app that opens its kind, through the system's one open.

tl.so.tilo.browser.reveal_download.Argum.description:
Shows where a saved download stands in Files, with the file marked: the system's one place for
what a window saved.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.dropped.Argume.description:
Moves an event where it was dropped: a day chip moves to that day keeping its time of day,
and an hour moves to the hour it was dropped at. A repeating event waits for its own answer.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.ended.Argument.description: Ends an event where its edge was dropped. A repeating event waits for its own answer.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.file_event.Arg.description: Files an event under a project, or files it under none.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.set_event_colo.description: Sets the colour an event is drawn in.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.clear_event_co.description: Takes an event's own colour off: it is drawn in its calendar's.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.set_categories.description: Sets the categories an event is filed under in its person's words.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.set_zone.Argum.description:
Sets the zone an event's wall times are read in: `Europe/Berlin`, `UTC`, or `floating` for
the same time of day everywhere.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.add_category.A.description: Files an event under one more category.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.remove_categor.description: Takes a category off an event.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.organize.Argum.description: Makes someone the organiser of an event.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.remind_at_star.description: Reminds the people coming when the event starts.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.remind_before..description: Reminds them a given number of minutes before it starts.

choice_labels.weekdays: The days chosen of every week

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.repeat_rule.Ar.description: Repeats an event, its rule in iCalendar's words, how often, and where it ends.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.repeat_weekday.description: Repeats an event on chosen days of the week from the day it stands on.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.toggle_weekday.description:
Adds a weekday to a weekly repeat, or takes it off: the days chosen are the rule's `BYDAY`,
and the repeat keeps the day it ends on, if it ends on one.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.repeat_off.Arg.description: Stops an event repeating from the day it stands on.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.skip_date.Argu.description: Skips one date of a repeating event.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.restore_date.A.description: Gives a skipped date of a repeating event back.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.move_occurrenc.description:
Moves one date of a repeating event: an event of its own stands in its place and the series
keeps every other date.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.cancel_occurre.description: Cancels one date of a repeating event.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.restore_occurr.description: Gives a cancelled or moved date of a series back.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.move_following.description:
Moves a repeating event from one date on: the series ends the day before, and a new one
begins where it was moved to, with every date after it.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.move_to_day.Ar.description:
Moves an event to a day, keeping the time of day it starts and how long it lasts, and its
reminder at the same distance from its start.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.change_day.Arg.description: Moves an event to the day a moment names, keeping the time of day it starts.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.change_start.A.description:
Sets the time of day an event starts, its end keeping how long it lasts. A day the moment
names is the day it moves to.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.move_end_day.A.description:
Ends an event on the day a moment names, keeping the time of day it ends at: a day after the
one it starts on makes it run through every day between, and a whole-day event ends at the
midnight after its last day, which is the day it shows on.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.end_on_day.Arg.description:
Ends an event on a day, keeping the time of day it ends at, as `move_end_day` does with the
day a moment names.

choice_labels.weekdays: The days chosen of every week

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.repeat.Argumen.description:
Repeats an event every day, week, month or year from the day it stands on, on the days
chosen of a week, and no longer on the days it named before.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.repeat_every.A.description: How often it repeats, in the unit it repeats in: every two weeks is 2.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.repeat_until.A.description: The last day it repeats by, or none for a series that does not end.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.repeat_until_a.description: The last day it repeats by, as the day a moment names.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.repeat_count.A.description: How many times it repeats in all, or none for a series that does not end.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.file_in.Argume.description: Files an event under a calendar the person picks.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.invite.Argumen.description: Invites someone to an event, by the name and address the person gives.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.answer.Argumen.description: Records someone's answer to an invitation: `accepted`, `declined` or `tentative`.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.answer_and_tel.description:
Answers the person's own invitation to an account's event, telling the organiser through the
account's server: what settles the RSVP the invitation asked for.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.uninvite.Argum.description: Takes someone off an event's guests: nothing is sent to them.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.invite_by_mail.description:
Starts a message inviting a guest, the event's calendar invitation carried beside it: what Mail
shows the person, to read and send. Nothing is sent by this.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.ring_due.Argum.description: Rings an event's reminder when its moment comes, and nothing for an event that has none.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.remind_now.Arg.description: Tells the people coming that an event starts, once, and clears its reminder.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.go_to.Argument.description: Goes to the week an event is on.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.repeat_every_t.description: Repeats an event how often the person typed, in the unit it repeats in: 2 for every other.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Event.repeat_count_t.description: Repeats an event as many times as the person typed.

the moment the words name.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.new_betwee.description: Makes an event of the hours dragged across, from where the drag began to where it ended.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.new_task.A.description: Adds a task to the inbox or to a project.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.add_step.A.description:
Adds a step under a task, in its project, and opens the task if it was done: there is work
under it now.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.remove_tas.description: Deletes a task and the steps under it.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.move_proje.description: Moves a project one place earlier or later among the projects.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.remove_pro.description: Deletes a project; its events and tasks go back to none.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.go_to_day..description: Stands the window on the day a moment names.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.sync.Argum.description:
Asks each account's server for its calendars now, so what it holds comes in as it does when
the server is heard from.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.new_calend.description: Adds a calendar of the workspace's own.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.discard_dr.description:
Throws away an event nothing was written in yet: what a person's New event leaves when they
decide against it.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.previous_w.description: The window shows the week before.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.next_week..description: The window shows the week after.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.previous_m.description: The window shows the month before.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.next_month.description: The window shows the month after.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.export_cal.description:
The calendar — every event and task it holds, or only one event — as an iCalendar file, for
a person to save or an agent to hand on. Nothing is written by this.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.take_invit.description:
Takes an invitation into the calendar: the event it asks for is kept by the account's server
where one can be written to it, so the organiser hears the answer, and by this workspace
otherwise. What the server took comes back with the account's next sync.

tl.so.tilo.calendar.Calendars.import_ics.description:
Imports the events and tasks of an iCalendar file, and answers how many it took: what a
person's own file offers, and what another calendar exported. A line naming a zone this
build cannot read is read in the person's zone.

repeating.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.set_grid.Argume.description: Shows the composition grid, or takes it away.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.set_level.Argum.description: Shows the level guide, or takes it away.

Opens the viewfinder.

Opens the code scanner.

Opens the document scanner.

Opens the capture settings.

Switches the viewfinder between photos and clips.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.use_camera.Argu.description: Uses the camera at this device node.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.retry_camera.Ar.description: Forgets the chosen camera and asks this device for its cameras again.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.list_cameras.Ar.description: Asks this device which cameras it has: the rows the settings page offers, one per camera.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.start_look.Argu.description: Starts the camera's moving picture: the window paints the newest frame as it arrives.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.stop_look.Argum.description: Stops the camera's moving picture, letting the device go.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.look.Arguments.description: Reads the codes the newest frame holds, keeping the first one the scanner view shows.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.read_codes.Argu.description: Decodes the codes in the picture at `url`, keeping the first one the scanner view shows.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.shutter.Argumen.description:
The shutter: takes a photo now, starts the self-timer, or records. Space presses it, as a
camera's shutter button is pressed.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.arm_timer.Argum.description: Arms the self-timer the person chose, or cancels the one counting down.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.capture.Argumen.description: Takes a photo of the frame the camera shows, and hands it on.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.start_recording.description: Starts recording from the frames the camera's engine thread takes.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.stop_recording..description: Stops the clip recording and hands it on once the engine has muxed it.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.poll.Arguments.description: Asks how far the recording and the document scan have got, finishing what is done.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.shutter_due.Arg.description: The self-timer's moment came: take the photo it counted down to, unless it was cancelled.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.import_image.Ar.description: Takes a chosen image as the code to read, without importing it.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.copy_code.Argum.description: Copies what the scanned code says, or its password or link.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.keep_scan.Argum.description: Keeps the scanned code in the history.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.set_scanner.Arg.description: Chooses the scanner the document scans with.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.capture_page.Ar.description: Captures one page with the chosen scanner and settings.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.rotate_page.Arg.description: Turns the selected page a quarter clockwise; its text is read again when the person asks.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.recognize_text..description: Reads the text off the selected page in the chosen language.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.copy_text.Argum.description: Copies the selected page's recognized text.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.move_page.Argum.description: Moves the selected page one place earlier, or later.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.crop_source.Arg.description: The selected page's picture, as the crop frame works on it.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.crop_page.Argum.description: Crops the selected page to the part the person kept; its text is read again when they ask.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.document_pdf.Ar.description:
The document as one searchable PDF: pages with recognized text carry it, the rest are
pictures alone.

tl.so.tilo.camera.Camera.open_recent.Arg.description: Opens the capture that was taken last in the app that owns its bytes.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.add_layer.Argu.description: Adds a layer on top of the artwork.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.rename_layer.A.description: Renames a layer. Two layers never share a name: a mark names its layer by it.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.lock_layer.Arg.description:
Holds a layer still, so the pointer passes through its marks, or lets its marks be picked
again.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.clip_layer.Arg.description: Holds a layer to the paint of the one under it, or lets it stand free.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.add_mask.Argum.description:
Adds a mask to a layer: a layer of greys the layer is seen through. Its marks are made with
the brushes as any layer's are, light showing the layer and dark hiding it.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.set_mask.Argum.description:
Sets a mask's grey before any mark, whether it hides where it is light, and whether it stays
put when its layer's marks move.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.add_text.Argum.description:
Adds a text mark: words set in the artwork's own fonts, at `x`, `y` (its first baseline) in
artwork units.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.set_medium.Arg.description:
Paints a layer with a medium: `oil`, `watercolour`, a preset saved in the artwork by its id,
or empty for plain vector paint.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.save_medium.Ar.description:
Saves a medium in the artwork, so its layers name it and every device paints it the same. A
medium of the same id is replaced.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.move_layer_up..description: Moves a layer one place up in the stack.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.move_layer_dow.description: Moves a layer one place down in the stack.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.duplicate_laye.description: Copies a layer and everything on it, above the original.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.merge_layer_do.description: Folds a layer into the one under it: its marks join that layer, and it is gone.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.set_artwork.Ar.description: Sets what the artwork is called and how big it is.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.add_stroke.Arg.description: Lays one brush stroke where the hand went, its point `[x, y, pressure]` in artwork units.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.extend_stroke..description: Adds the next point to the stroke being painted.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.top_layer.Argu.description:
The layer a stroke lands on when none is chosen: the top one that shows and is not held
still. An artwork whose layers are all hidden or locked gains one to paint on.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.add_shape.Argu.description: Draws a shape, its SVG path data in artwork units.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.resize_mark.Ar.description: Makes a mark bigger or smaller.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.place_picture..description:
Places a picture the person chose on the top layer, fitted inside the artwork and centred:
the picture stays its own object, so it moves, crops and syncs like paint.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.select_like.Ar.description:
Selects what the colour at `at` touches in the artwork's picture, or that colour everywhere:
the magic wand. The area comes back as a selection the fill, mask and outline use.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.select_subject.description:
Selects the picture's subject, found by the on-device model the person set up, with its edge
fitted to the picture's own edges over `refine` units where that is asked.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.refine_selecti.description:
Refines the selection's edge to the picture's own edges over `refine` units, keeping fur and
hair soft.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.combine_marks..description:
Combines the marks into one path, in the bottom one's place and colour: shapes united,
subtracted, intersected or excluded. The engine works out the outline; the artwork keeps one
mark where there were several.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.measure_marks..description:
Weighs the marks' ink as the eye sees it: each one's ink box, ink area, centre of mass and
its offset from the box's middle, so two icons balance when their areas and offsets match.
The answer is the engine's JSON; the window says it in words.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.set_reference..description:
Sets the picture to work from, fitted inside the artwork and centred. It is not part of the
work: comparing shows the artwork beside, over or against it, and export never includes it.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.compare_refere.description:
Shows the artwork beside (`side-by-side`), over (`overlay`) or against (`difference`) the
reference picture, as a new file, with how far apart they are.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.compare_versio.description:
Compares the artwork with the version history names, overlaid on the surface: what changed
between the two, and the changed region as it now stands where it stands.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.clear_comparis.description: Takes the version comparison away from the surface.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.ask_selection..description: Asks the engine for a selection, and keeps the area it answers.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.select_shape.A.description:
Selects a rectangle or an ellipse from one corner of a drag to the other, meeting the area
there is by `mode` (`replace`, `add`, `subtract` or `intersect`).

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.select_lasso.A.description: Selects the area a lasso traces, closed, meeting the area there is by `mode`.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.select_outline.description: Selects the area an outline names, meeting the area there is by `mode`.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.grow_selection.description: Grows (or shrinks, when negative) the selection's edge by `by` units.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.invert_selecti.description: Turns the selection inside out: everything in the artwork but what it held.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.select_marks.A.description: Selects the shape of the marks or groups `ids` name, meeting the area there is by `mode`.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.pick_mark.Argu.description: Picks a mark, or lets it go: combine and measure act on the picked marks.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.pick_marks.Arg.description: Picks the marks, adding any that were not picked.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.remove_along.A.description:
Removes the brush strokes a path crosses, on `layer` or every layer: what a stroke eraser
does. Answers how many went.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.inspect_artwor.description:
Lists what the artwork holds: its layers and newest marks, with ids, bounds and colours,
and with `palette` the colours it paints with. The answer is the engine's JSON.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.select_area.Ar.description: Selects an area, its outline as SVG path data.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.fill_selection.description: Fills the selection as a path mark on a layer.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.draw_look.Argu.description: The picture of the artwork as it stands, kept on it, so the surface shows it under the hand.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.export_picture.description: Writes the artwork at full size as a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.export_svg.Arg.description: Writes the artwork as an SVG document.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.save_artwork.A.description: Saves the artwork as a `.artwork` package carrying its pictures.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.import_svg.Arg.description:
Imports an SVG document as marks on a layer: each shape the device's drawing engine read from
it becomes a mark, so the import is drawn, saved and shown like paint the person laid.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.clear_notice.A.description: Clears the notice a person has read.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.start_paint.Ar.description:
Starts what the hand lays down at `point`: a stroke with the paint loaded, or nothing when the
tool draws a shape, whose outline only exists once the hand lifts. It lands on `layer`, the
one the person chose, or the top one that takes paint.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.continue_paint.description:
Takes the next point of the stroke being painted. A shape tool paints nothing while the hand
moves: its outline is drawn when the hand lifts.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Artwork.finish_paint.A.description:
Ends what the hand laid down at `point`: the stroke takes its last point and closes, or a
shape is drawn across the drag that made it.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.group_mark.Argume.description:
Puts a mark in the folder `group`, or takes it out when that is empty. Marks of a group are
addressed, exported and shown together.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.fill_gradient.Arg.description:
Fills a mark with a gradient from `from` to `to`, its stops given as offsets 0 to 1 beside
their colours.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.wet_mark.Argument.description: Paints a mark into what is still wet, or over dry paint.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.clear_gradient.Ar.description: Clears a mark's gradient, leaving the plain colour.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.set_text.Argument.description: Sets a text mark's words, its type and its setting. A parameter left out stays as it is.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.crop_picture.Argu.description:
Shows part of the picture: the frame `x`, `y`, `width`, `height` of its own pixels, each a
fraction of them. The picture stays put and the frame follows, so a crop is an edit of the
mark and never of the pixels.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.straighten_pictur.description: Turns the picture inside its frame, in degrees, enlarging it so no corner shows.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.flip_picture.Argu.description: Mirrors the picture across its middle.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.blend_mark.Argume.description: Sets how a mark mixes with what is under it.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.adjust_mark.Argum.description:
Grades a mark without touching its pixels: exposure, contrast and the rest are kept on the
mark and applied wherever the artwork is shown or exported. A parameter left out stays as it
is, so an agent changes one step at a time.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.move_mark.Argumen.description: Moves a mark by `dx`, `dy` artwork units.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.clip_mark.Argumen.description: Cuts a mark to the shape of another mark or a group, or lets it stand whole.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.finish_mark.Argum.description:
Sets how a mark is finished: nearest-neighbour pixels, grain, a feathered edge, and its
shadows. A parameter left out stays as it is.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.set_curve.Argumen.description: Sets a mark's tone curve, `[[in, out], …]` from 0 to 1.

tl.so.tilo.canvas.Mark.set_dynamics.Argu.description:
Sets how the brush lays a mark: its flow, hardness, spacing, smoothing and taper, each 0 to
1. A parameter left out stays as it is.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.$scenario..description: The data the app's shots and demos start from is written.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.new_channe.description:
Adds a text channel to the sidebar, under `category` when it is given and about `topic` when
that is.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.new_catego.description: Adds a category to the sidebar.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.new_voice_.description: Adds a voice channel to the sidebar, under `category` when it is given.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.new_skill..description:
Starts a skill, called `name`. What it is for and how its work is done are written on its
page, or by an agent told to share the guidance with the workspace.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.report_pro.description:
Files a problem report, what someone ran into while using Tilo, in the workspace's #feedback
channel, which the first report opens.

The people who read the reports there answer, react and start a thread under one as under any
message. The channel is made under one key on every device, so reports filed apart open one.

A report carries a recording of what happened where one was kept (Capture's last half minute,
or any recording the person chose): it rides on the message as its file, and the report's row
offers to replay it.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.message_pe.description:
Opens the direct message between the invoker and `who`, in the sidebar, or the one already
open between the two of them: two people have one conversation, not a new empty one each
time. With yourself it is your notes to self. A person is someone of the workspace: one who
is not in it is refused, since no one but its members reads what is written here.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.conversati.description:
The direct conversation between the invoker and `who`, none while the two of them have none:
what an agent, a script or another app reads to find it, opening and making nothing. With
yourself it is your notes to self.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.write_to.A.description:
Writes `body` to `who`, a person or an agent, in the one direct conversation with them: the
one already open, else a new one in the sidebar. The message is sent as every message is.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.delete_cha.description: Deletes a channel and what was said in it, from the sidebar or the category it is in.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.delete_cat.description: Deletes a category that holds no channel.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.move_chann.description:
Moves a channel to a place in the sidebar: under `category`, or outside any, at `at` among
the channels listed there (the end when it is negative). A move keeps the channel and what
was written in it.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.move_categ.description:
Moves a category to a place in the sidebar, at `at` among the categories and channels listed
there (the end when it is negative). Its own channels move with it.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.report_per.description:
Reports a person to the workspace's moderators, for how they behave here rather than for one
message: what the reporter says is the whole of it, and the moderators decide it as any other
report.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.ban.Argume.description:
Bans a person from the workspace: they leave it and stay out until a moderator lifts the ban.
The workspace's own ban decides who may, its owners and moderators; Chat keeps the ban on the
moderators' Reports page as a decided report, which overturning lifts.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Conversations.ask_for_su.description:
Asks the assistant to start a sub-agent for `job`, in the direct conversation it answers in:
the record's own `start-sub-agent` is the assistant's to call there, and the sub-agent reports
in that conversation, where the person follows it. None where the workspace keeps no
conversation with the assistant yet.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.bridge.Argum.description:
How one kind of work is done in this workspace: what a person writes down once, and what an
agent reads before it starts that work.
Carries a conversation to an outside service: its name as people read it ("Discord") and
the id it has there. The bridge's own actions keep what joins the two sides; this is what

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.unbridge.Arg.description: Keeps a conversation here: no service carries it any more.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.send.Argumen.description:
Posts a message in a channel, a thread or a direct conversation as the invoker, answering
another when `reply_to` names one. History and the catch-up say what a person did in its own
words, counting the messages a step of them holds. A message in a direct conversation is news
to the other people in it: each is told once, on every device of theirs, who wrote and what,
and choosing the notice opens the conversation.

A composer names the person's `draft`: what it holds is the message, and the draft is emptied in
the same change, so the press is one step to undo. What is sent without a draft is the `body`
given, as a program writing a message says it. A reply an agent's `turn` writes begins empty
and takes the model's words as it writes them.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.summarize.Ar.description:
Writes down what has been said in a conversation so far, replacing what was written before:
what an agent's next turn there reads in place of the messages it covers.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.send_view.Ar.description:
Sends a view as a message: its title as what the message says, its definition for anyone
who reads it to add to their own views.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.share_window.description:
Shares one of the person's windows live into a conversation: the shell shares the window with
the workspace, as its own window bar does, and the message refers to that share, so the
conversation shows the window live where the message stands. Its sharer chooses whether the
members viewing it may control it.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.relay.Argume.description:
Posts a message written on another service, as it was written there: who wrote it, as that
service names them, where and when. A bridge relays another service's conversation this
way; the message's history names the bridge, and the message says whom it relays.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.rename_chann.description: Renames a text channel. What was said in it stays.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.set_topic.Ar.description: Says what a channel is for, in its topic.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.archive_chan.description: Sets a channel aside, out of the sidebar, keeping everything said in it, or brings it back.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.continue_ans.description:
Asks the agent that wrote `m` to carry on where its answer stopped: a reply to it from the
person, naming the agent, which the agent's next turn reads with the answer before it. An answer that ran out
of room, was stopped or broke off is finished this way, not written again from its start.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.delete.Argum.description:
Deletes a message from the channel or thread it is in. Its author, or anyone the
channel's permissions allow, may: the platform undoes it rather than asking first, and the
removal is a version of the message, so who removed it stays answerable. Its reports stay,
saying it was deleted, as far as the one deleting reads them.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.report.Argum.description:
Reports a message of a conversation to the workspace's moderators, saying why when the
reporter does. Who reported it is the report's history's, so moderators see who asked; the
conversation keeps it, with who wrote the message and what it said, after the message is
deleted.

tl.so.tilo.chat.TextChannel.start_thread.description:
Starts a thread from a message of a channel or a direct conversation, named after what the
message says.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Message.relay_reaction.A.description:

whom it relays.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Message.edit.Arguments.description:
Changes what a message says. Only its author may. An agent retrying its answer writes it
again in the same message, naming the new turn.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Message.pin.Arguments.description: Pins a message to its channel, or unpins it.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Message.react.Arguments.description: Adds your reaction with an emoji to a message, or takes it back when you had reacted with it.

tl.so.tilo.chat.Message.copy_text.Argume.description: Copies what a message says, as plain words, to the clipboard.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.import_fi.description:
Imports the engineering evidence a JSON file holds: an analytical storage report or a
hardware verification receipt. This is what a person's files and the file chooser hand the
app, and importing the same bytes twice keeps one record.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.import_re.description: Imports an analytical storage report from its JSON.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.import_ve.description: Imports a hardware verification receipt from its JSON.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.take_in.A.description:
Takes in one imported document, whichever it is: the device checks it first, and what it
holds reaches the project only once its own contract accepts it.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.keep_repo.description: Keeps one analytical storage report and the assumptions and scope it states.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.keep_rece.description:
Keeps one hardware verification receipt: its scope, its checks, the identities it reports,
and whichever of the three reported protocols it speaks.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.remove_re.description: Removes a report and everything it stated.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.remove_ve.description: Removes a verification receipt and everything it stated.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.show_all..description: Lists every report and receipt the project holds.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.inspect_s.description: Shows one stage of the receipt the window holds open.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.inspect_m.description: Shows one macro of the placement the window holds open.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.open_subf.description: Opens the receipt an evidence flow's subflow reference names, when its summary is imported.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.dismiss.A.description: Shrugs off the line about the last refusal or success.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.zoom_grap.description: Zooms the operator graph in, out, or back to its whole extent.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.select_ou.description: Chooses the output a person connects from, naming the inputs it can feed.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.clear_out.description: Leaves the graph without a chosen output.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.inspect_o.description: Shows one operator's own facts, or closes them.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.add_opera.description: Adds an operator of `kind` after the ones already in the graph, on a four-wide grid.

Adds one operator with exactly the shape, matrix width and place a caller gives it. The
device checks the whole design before any of it is kept.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.set_shape.description:
Reshapes one operator. Its last axis sets the normalization width, and every connection the
new shape cannot hold stops holding.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.apply_sha.description: Applies the shape a person typed for one operator, when it names one.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.apply_wid.description: Applies the matrix output width a person typed for one operator.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.tap_macro.description: Shows one placement macro of the stage the window holds open.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.set_outpu.description: Sets the matrix output width of one operator.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.move_oper.description: Moves one operator to a place on the canvas.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.remove_op.description:
Removes one operator, and every connection it held. Every other connection holds as it did:
removing an operator takes only its own edges, and no other operator's ports change.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.connect.A.description:
Connects one output to one input. The device refuses a connection whose types differ, whose
input another connection holds, or that would close a cycle.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.disconnec.description: Disconnects every connection into one input.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.resolve_g.description: Resolves the whole design again, so what the window shows is what the stored design makes.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.apply_gra.description:
Keeps the ports and connection outcomes the device answered, so the window draws and
refuses by the design's own resolution.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.inspect_s.description: Shows one macro the person picked from the placement's own list.

tl.so.tilo.chip-design.Project.tap_graph.description:
A press on the canvas: an operator's title opens its facts, an output is what the next input
connects from, and an input connects or opens its operator.

tl.so.tilo.clocks.Alarm.edit_alarm.Argum.description:
Changes an alarm's words, time and days. Its on/off state stays as it was, and one that is on
rings next at the time it now names.

tl.so.tilo.clocks.Alarm.set_alarm_enable.description: Turns an alarm on or off: off, it does not ring; on, it rings next at its time.

tl.so.tilo.clocks.Alarm.set_alarm_device.description: Names the device an alarm rings on: one device's id, or none for every device of the person's.

tl.so.tilo.clocks.Alarm.toggle_day.Argum.description:
Repeats an alarm on `d`, or stops repeating on it: a day it names rings, a day it does not
skips. Its next ring moves to the next day it names.

tl.so.tilo.clocks.Alarm.snooze_alarm.Arg.description: Snoozes the alarm ringing now: it rings again in five minutes.

tl.so.tilo.clocks.Alarm.ring_alarm.Argum.description:
Rings an alarm when its moment comes, on the device it names, window or no window. A repeating
alarm rings again the next day it names; one that rings once turns itself off.

tl.so.tilo.clocks.Timer.ring_timer.Argum.description: Rings a timer when it finishes, on every device of the person's, window or no window.

tl.so.tilo.clocks.Clocks.pause_stopwatch.description: Pauses the stopwatch where it stands.

tl.so.tilo.clocks.Clocks.lap.Arguments.description: Keeps a lap: the time the stopwatch stands at.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.replace_tex.description: Writes `text` as the whole file, for an agent or a script that holds a file's new text.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.replace_ran.description:
Replaces `count` characters from `at` with `text`: a range or a caret in one file, counted in
characters from its start.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.duplicate_l.description: Copies a line of the file to the line under it.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.move_line.A.description: Moves a line over the one above it (`up`) or under the one below it.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.delete_line.description: Deletes a line of the file.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.toggle_comm.description:
Comments out a line, or takes its comment away when the line stands commented already: the
marker is the language's own, at the line's own indentation.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.indent_line.description: Adds one indentation step to a line.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.outdent_lin.description: Takes one indentation step off a line.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.find_text.A.description:
Finds the words `text` in a file, the case of their letters aside unless `case` says
otherwise; `word` matches only where they stand alone as a word.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.replace_in_.description: Replaces every place the words `text` stand in a file, answering how many changed.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.symbols.Arg.description:
The declarations a file's text writes — `fn`, `struct`, `enum`, `trait`, `class`, `def`,
`interface`, `type`, `const` — each with the line and column it stands at: what the
project's symbols are and what go-to-symbol offers.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.reveal_line.description: Shows `line` of `entry`, counted from 0: the editor scrolls it into view with the caret on it.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Entry.add_child.A.description: Starts a file inside the folder `e`: a row's "+", pressed.
