tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.new_file..description:
Starts a file called `name` in `folder`, holding `text`: what a person types in the project,
what a drop makes, and where an import lands.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.rename.Ar.description: Renames `entry` to `name`, keeping the names in its folder apart.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.move_entr.description:
Moves `entry` into `folder` (the top of the project when none), just before `before` — or
after every entry there when none names one.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.move_afte.description: Moves `entry` just after `after`, as a drop on the row below asks.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.delete.Ar.description:
Deletes `entry`, and every entry under it: a folder empties with its entries, as one change
a person takes back at once.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.find_in_w.description:
The window's search finds the words in the open file and across the project's files: the
first place in the file is shown, so a hit is in sight as the words are typed.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.check.Arg.description:
Checks a file and keeps what it found: the device's server's problems when one answers for
the file, the editor's own otherwise.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.open_fold.description:
Opens the folder `folder` as the project: each file and folder it holds, read as entries,
and each file's bytes as its text.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.read_into.description:
Records the entries `answer` lists, standing in `folder`, and reads a file's own bytes:
the tree is the project's, so every file the project shows is one a save can check. The
listing crosses an action call as the text the device answered, which it already is.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.open_file.description:
Opens a file a person chose, or one Files or another app handed over: `file` is the file it
is, and its words become an entry of the project.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.save.Argu.description:
Writes a file's text to the device, checking first that the bytes there are the ones this
project read: a file something else changed is not written over without the person saying
so.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.overwrite.description: Saves a file over the device's change, as a person chose after reading what changed.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.reload.Ar.description: Reads the file again from the device, dropping what changed here.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.save_all..description: Writes every file that changed here to the device.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.save_into.description: Writes `entry` into the folder `files` names, under its own name.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.move_on_d.description: Moves a file into the folder `to` of the project, on the device as in the tree.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.import_dr.description:
Imports the files a person dropped on the window: a folder becomes a folder of the project,
a text file an entry with its words.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.run.Argum.description:
Runs `command` in the project's folder, as the terminal does: its output and its exit status
are kept with the command, and a person reads them beside the code.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.stop.Argu.description: Stops the command that runs in the project now.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.rerun.Arg.description: Runs a command of the project's terminal again, as a person does from its history.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.rerun_tes.description:
Runs one test of a run again: the command with the test's name after it, run as that run's
tool ran it.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.open_term.description: Opens the project's folder in the system's terminal: the shell a person runs by hand.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.poll.Argu.description:
Asks how far the running commands and the project search have got, once a second while
anything runs: the one place the device's answers are folded into what the window shows.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.reveal_it.description:
Brings the caret to the place an item of a command's output names: the file is read if the
project does not hold it yet, and the page shows it.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.go_to_lin.description: Shows `line` of the file at `path`, counted from 0.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.search_pr.description:
Searches every file of the project for `needle`, the case of its letters aside unless
`case` says otherwise.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.open_hit..description:
Shows the place a search found: the file is read from the device when the project does not
hold it yet, and the page opens it.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.ensure_se.description:
Starts the language server for a file's language, if none runs for it yet, and tells it
about the file.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.announce..description:
Tells the server that `entry` is open, with the text it holds now, so its answers are about
what a person reads.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.poll_serv.description:
Reads what the server answered: its state and progress, its problems for each file, and any
answer to a code-help ask the page made.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.read_answ.description:
Reads the answer the server gave to the page's last ask: a completion list, the words a
hover shows, the places a declaration stands at, or the edits a format makes.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.complete..description: Asks the server for completions at a place in a file.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.hover.Arg.description: Asks the server what stands at a place in a file.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.definitio.description: Asks the server where the declaration at a place is written.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.accept_co.description: Writes the completion a person chose where the caret stands.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.format_fi.description: Reformats a file as its language's formatter does, as one change.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.toggle_la.description: Turns language servers on or off, for the project.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.toggle_fo.description: Turns formatting a file on save on or off.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.restart_s.description: Stops the language server, as a person pressing "Try again" after a failure does.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.show_prob.description: Shows the file's problems under the code, as the window's own key does anywhere in it.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.show_term.description: Shows the project's terminal under the code, as Ctrl+J does anywhere in the window.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.show_sear.description:
Shows what the project search found under the code, as Ctrl+Shift+F does anywhere in the
window.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.ensure_se.description: This person's settings, made by their own first change so they are theirs to read and write.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.zoom_in.A.description:
Shows the code one step larger: the editor's own text size, kept for the person on every
device.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.zoom_out..description: Shows the code one step smaller.

tl.so.tilo.code-editor.Project.zoom_rese.description: Shows the code at its own size again.

tl.so.tilo.console.Window.publish.Argume.description:
Gives each of the newest sessions the history lists, and each client that acted here, a
resource of its own, so each can be linked to, found and opened outside this window. An
insert under a key a resource already stands under leaves that resource as it stands, so a
reading that answers again changes nothing twice.

tl.so.tilo.console.Window.session_link.A.description:
The resource of the session `run`, made now when the window has not published it yet: every
way of opening a session goes through it, so the list, a link, search and another app open
the same window.

tl.so.tilo.console.Window.agent_card.Arg.description:
The card of `client`, made now when the window has not published it yet: every way of opening
a client's card goes through it.

tl.so.tilo.console.Window.stop_client.Ar.description:
Stops the client's working session, keeping its grant: the card's own Stop, by the client a
card, a palette or an agent names.

tl.so.tilo.console.Window.take_over_clie.description:
Stops the client's session and opens what it changed last: the card's own Take over, by the
client a card, a palette or an agent names.

tl.so.tilo.console.Window.undo_client_se.description:
Takes back every change of the client's newest session: the card's own Undo session, by the
client a card, a palette or an agent names.

tl.so.tilo.console.Window.revoke_client..description:
Takes back the grant the client came in by: the card's own Revoke, by the client a card, a
palette or an agent names.

tl.so.tilo.console.Window.let_client_go_.description:
Lets a stopped client's calls through again: the card's own Let it go on, by the client a
card, a palette or an agent names.

tl.so.tilo.console.Window.open_connect.A.description: Shows how an agent or another computer connects as this person: the window opens at Connect.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Contact.add_email.Ar.description:

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Contact.remove_email.description: Takes one of a contact's mailboxes away.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Contact.add_address..description: Gives a contact a postal address to fill in.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Contact.remove_addre.description: Takes one of a contact's addresses away.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Contact.keep_birthda.description:
Keeps a birthday with its year or without it: a birthday kept without one is the day it falls
on every year, as many address books keep one.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Contact.ungroup.Argu.description: Takes a contact out of a group.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.new_contact.Arg.description:
A new contact, named by what is typed where they were made; a book's entry gives the name
it takes, so nothing is left called "No name yet" by a person who typed one.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.named_or_new.Ar.description:
Finds the contact the workspace keeps under `name`, or adds one: what brings someone in from
another service — a task given to them before they joined — to one card, however many imports
name them.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.group.Arguments.description:
Puts a contact in a group, making the group the book's place if it is new: the same group
however it is spelled, so "Work" and "work" are one place.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.new_group.Argum.description: Starts a group the book offers as a place, with nobody in it yet.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.delete.Argument.description:
Deletes a contact from the book, and with it the person the workspace's apps know of it where
the window hands the directory: what Mail, Calendar and Messages reach it by goes too.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.merge_into.Argu.description:
Merges the card that goes into the one that stays: every number, mailbox, address and group of
both is the card that stays, the fields `take` names come from the card that goes, and the
card that goes is deleted. One change, so undo brings both cards back.

choice_labels.v3: vCard 3.0, which older address books read: dates with their dashes and kinds in capitals
choice_labels.v4: vCard 4.0, the current format: dates in its compact form and kinds in lower case

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.export_book.Arg.description: Every contact as one vCard file, which another address book reads whole.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.export_vcard_co.description:
Every contact as the text of one card file, or the one `name` calls: for an agent or a script
that hands the cards on where a person's file chooser cannot, as the address its bytes are
kept at. A name the book holds twice is refused rather than guessed.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.import_vcard.Ar.description:
Imports the contacts a vCard file holds into the book, each new card a contact of its own, and
answers what it did. A card whose id the book already holds unchanged is nobody new; one that
says something else about the person waits in the book's review, and the contact stays as it
is until someone says which card is theirs. A file beyond what this app reads is refused whole:
what the refusal says is why.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.add_contacts.Ar.description:
The cards `cards`, the words of a vCard file, as contacts of this book, and what became of
each: what an importer, an agent or a script hands a book in one call.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.refuse_import.A.description:
The report of an import of `skipped` cards, and no others: what a file that could not be read
answers.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.report_import.A.description: What an import did, kept on the book for the window's banner to read and answer.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.dismiss_import..description: The person has read what the last import did: the banner stops showing it.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.file_card.Argum.description:
Brings one card of a vCard file to the book: takes it as a contact, finds the book already
holds it unchanged, puts it up for review where it says something else about a contact the
book holds by the same id, or refuses a card that names nobody. `uid` is the id the caller
gives a card whose file names none, so the caller can find the contact it makes.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.take_card.Argum.description:
The contact a card makes in the book, under the id `id`: what a new card becomes, and what a
card someone chose over the one the book held becomes. Its rows are filled after it stands in
the book, as every resource's are.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.add_card.Argume.description:
The contact a vCard card says, made in the book, or none for a card that names nobody and for
one the book already holds: the single-card form of importing a file.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.import_as_new.A.description:
Takes a card that waited for review as a contact of its own, beside the one the book holds
under the id it named: the file's card is the person's, and the card the book kept keeps
everything of its own. Its id is new, because the two cards are two now.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.keep_existing.A.description: Leaves the card the book holds as it is, and takes the file's card out of the review.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.Book.find_for_addres.description:
The contact the book holds for `address`, as an action: what a person, an agent or another
app asks before they write to it. Nothing is changed and nothing is guessed from a name.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.confirm.Arguments.description:
Binds `account` of `service` to the person: the directory's `confirm-endpoint`, or
`confirm-account` where the service names an account scope.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.change.Arguments.description:
Changes the account an association names, under the directory's rule that a changed address
needs review before anything is sent to it.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.forget.Arguments.description:
Takes an association away: messages from that account stop reaching this contact, and what was
already received is unchanged.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.share.Arguments.description:
Shares this card with the workspace's apps, under the person it is: the name, the numbers and
the mailboxes another app reads of a contact before it writes to them. The card keeps that
person's id, so it stops being shared, or is shared again, as the same person.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.share_card.Arguments.description:
Shares a card the workspace's apps do not know yet: a person of its own is made for it, so Mail,
Calendar and Messages can name it and find it by its numbers and mailboxes.

tl.so.tilo.contacts.unshare.Arguments.description:
Takes the contact out of the directory, leaving its card in the book: what the apps read of it
stops naming it, and the card is no person of the directory's until it is shared again.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.load_query.description: Loads a saved query into the editor, ready to run.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.load_start.description: Puts a starter query in the editor, saved so the person can name it too.

choice_labels.data: One page of the selected table's rows

choice_labels.structure: The selected table's columns, keys and indexes

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.show_tab.A.description: Shows one of the window's three views.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.begin_tran.description:
Starts a transaction on the open connection: what runs until the person commits is one
change, and rolling it back takes all of it back.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.commit_tra.description: Commits the open transaction: what it changed is the database's from now on.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.rollback_t.description: Rolls the open transaction back: every change it made is taken back.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.run.Argume.description: Runs the statement in the editor, asking first when it changes data.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.confirm_ru.description: Runs the statement the person confirmed.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.dismiss_ru.description: Puts away the statement that was waiting for confirmation.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.run_query..description: Runs a saved query against the open connection.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.rerun.Argu.description: Runs a statement this window ran before.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.start_stat.description:
Starts `sql` on the open connection as a job, so the window stays live and the statement can
be stopped.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.browse.Arg.description: Opens the table `t`: what it is made of, and its first page of rows.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.load_struc.description: Reads the selected table's keys and indexes; its columns came with the catalog.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.load_page..description: Loads one page of the selected table's rows.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.next_page..description: Shows the next page of the selected table's rows.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.previous_p.description: Shows the page before the one shown.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.refresh_ca.description: Reads the open connection's catalog again, so a table made elsewhere shows.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.order_by.A.description: Orders the result by the column the person chose, or back to the statement's own order.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.copy_row.A.description: Copies the result row at `at` as one line of text.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.copy_resul.description: Copies the whole result as tab-separated text.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.export_csv.description: The statement's result as a CSV file, for a person to keep.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.dismiss.Ar.description: Clears what the window last said.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.check.Argu.description:
Asks how far the job in flight has got, and folds its answer in. A job this device does not
run says so, and leaves the window as it is.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.opened.Arg.description: Takes a connection's handle in, once the engine opened it, and reads its catalog.

tl.so.tilo.db-client.Database.queried.Ar.description: Takes a statement's result in, with the words the window shows of it.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.open_compar.description: Compares two texts: what a script, an agent or another app asks of Diff & Merge.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.chosen_left.description:
The action the person's file chooser fills for the left side: the left file, and then the
right one.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.chosen_righ.description: The action the person's file chooser fills for the right side.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.refresh_com.description:
Asks the device to align the two sides, and holds what it made: the aligned columns, the rows
that changed and how many of each.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.open_merge..description: Merges three texts: a common base and the two versions of it a person has.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.refresh_mer.description: Asks the device to hunk the merge and compose the result with what the person took so far.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.take_ours.A.description: Takes our side for a change.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.take_theirs.description: Takes their side for a change.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.take_both.A.description: Takes both sides for a change, ours first.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.resolve.Arg.description: Resolves a change with the person's own text.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.compare_fol.description:
Compares the two folders at `left` and `right` on this device: what only one holds, and what
both hold but differ in. Two absolute paths, or two empty ones to choose the folders at the
window.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.chosen_fold.description: The action the person's folder chooser fills for the left tree.

The action the person's folder chooser fills for the right tree: both chosen, the folders are
compared.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.open_folder.description:
Opens one file of the folder comparison: both its sides when both trees hold it, else the one
that does, against nothing.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.open_on_key.description: Opens the file of the row the person pressed, for the key that asked: Enter opens it.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.edit_merged.description:
Replaces the merged result: what a person types into it, and what an agent or a script writes
when the result is theirs to change. Once it is not what the sides compose, taking a side
would throw the edit away, so the rest is resolved in the text.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.save_merged.description: Writes the merged result to `path` on this device.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.save_bytes..description:
The merged result as a file the person places with the system's save chooser, which the window
shows.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.fill_sample.description:
Fills a comparison with the samples: the two-way comparison and the three-way merge, so a
person sees how each reads before they have two files at hand.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Session.sample_fold.description: Shows the sample folder comparison: no disk is read for it.

Opens the two files at `left` and `right` on this device and compares them. Two absolute
paths, or two empty ones to choose the files at the window.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Library.open_one.Ar.description:
Opens one file on this device against nothing: what a folder comparison shows for a file only
one tree holds. `side` is `left` or `right`.

tl.so.tilo.diffmerge.Library.load_sample.description:
Opens the sample comparison and the sample merge, so a person sees how each reads before they
have two files at hand.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.clear.description: Forgets what the setup last said went wrong.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.ask_t.description:
Asks the bridge's program to have the bot's token put in the person's vault: the person types
it once on the system's own card, and the vault keeps it. This account keeps the item's
address, never the token.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.keep_.description:
Keeps the vault item the person's token was put in: the program's answer to `ask_token`. The
item's address is all this record keeps.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.find_.description:
Finds the servers the bot is in, so one can be chosen: the bridge's program asks Discord with
the token the vault keeps.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.found.description: The servers finding the bot's servers answered: the program's answer to `find_servers`.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.choos.description:
The server the person chose to bring in: the program reads its channels so one of them can be
brought in alone.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.found.description: The server's channels as the program read them: the program's answer to `choose_server`.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.choos.description: Chooses the one channel of the server to bring in, or none for the whole server.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.back_.description: Goes back from the channels to the servers, choosing again.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.setup.description: Why the setup step `ask` did not work: the program's answer, in words the person reads.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.bridg.description:
Binds this account to the server and channels the setup chose. The server's layout stays
Discord's until the import ran.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.conne.description: Binds this account to one server. The server's layout stays Discord's until the import ran.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.obser.description:
Records Discord's layout as the latest event reported it: channels and roles the layout no
longer lists go, the ones it lists are brought up to date, and new ones come in.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.map.A.description: Joins a conversation, message or the like here to its Discord side.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.unmap.description: Forgets a mapping, keeping the two sides apart from now on when asked.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.conne.description:
Starts signing in with Discord, as the person looking: the bridge's program builds the
consent page and the state that binds what comes back to them.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.start.description:
Where the person goes to sign in with Discord, and the digest of the state that binds what
comes back to them: the program's answer to `connect_account`.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.offer.description:
Offers a Discord account for linking, from the server: `/link` answered with a one-time
token, whose check this is. The offer stands ten minutes, replacing any run out and any
other offer kept under the same check.

Offers the account that signed in on Discord's consent page, to the person who started the
round trip `state_sha256` names.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.compl.description:
Links the Discord account a one-time token offers to the person looking. The offer is used
up, and a link the person had before is replaced.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.set_s.description:
Offers signing in with Discord: this device's consent page, without its state; empty for
none.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.answe.description: Edits a slash command's reply to what came of it.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.renam.description: Takes a linked account's newer names and avatar.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.set_l.description: Keeps a linked account's avatar as the person's picture, until they upload their own.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.unlin.description: Unlinks a Discord account: its person's, or the bridge's.
Unlinks the person's own Discord account.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.block.description:
Stops mirroring a Discord account: its messages are no longer carried, and the ones already
here are removed. It is not banned there.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.remem.description: Remember where an avatar's image is stored.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.finis.description: Finishes adopting the server: everything in it is here now.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.send_.description:
Sends a message through a channel's webhook, as the bridge plans it. The call arrives as the
JSON the bridge's program writes, and is read as the record its shape declares.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.edit_.description: Edits a message the bridge sent.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.start.description: Starts a thread on a message.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.apply.description: Creates a channel there, or brings it back in line.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.arran.description: Puts channels and categories in their places there, so the server lists them in this order.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.may_m.description:
Says whether the bridge may change the server's channels: mirroring is on and the server is
adopted.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.may_c.description: Says whether the bridge made the Discord channel or category `id` for one here.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.apply.description: Creates a role there, or brings it back in line.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.set_m.description: Sets a linked member's roles there.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.set_o.description: Sets a channel's permission overwrite, for a role the bridge made.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.fetch.description: Copies a file from Discord's CDN into the workspace's content store.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.apply.description: Uploads a workspace emoji to the server, or renames one the bridge uploaded.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.delet.description: Deletes an emoji the bridge uploaded.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.settl.description: Records what became of an emoji upload, rename or delete.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.repor.description: Says why the bridge cannot carry voice now, or that it can again.

tl.so.tilo.discord.preview.Discord.pump..description:
A value nothing reads, for the trigger's frame that does nothing itself: the origin polls
Discord's events and the conversations here in its own loop.

own; each chapter becomes a resource holding its words, so the book is searchable and a
reader opens the chapter they are at.

and how the article's page is set.

tl.so.tilo.feeds.Library.add_subscriptio.description: Subscribes to a feed's address, or shows the subscription this library already has.

tl.so.tilo.feeds.Library.unsubscribe.Arg.description:
Unsubscribes: the subscription leaves the sidebar, and what it brought in is taken away with
it. Undo brings both back.

tl.so.tilo.feeds.Library.new_folder.Argu.description:
Starts a folder that keeps related subscriptions together; its subscriptions stay when it
goes.

tl.so.tilo.feeds.Library.delete_folder.A.description: Deletes a folder; its subscriptions stay, at the top of the sidebar.

tl.so.tilo.feeds.Library.mark_read.Argum.description: Marks everything the place `place` lists as read.

tl.so.tilo.feeds.Library.refresh.Argumen.description:
Reads every subscription again. The device fetches them away from the frame and the app takes
each answer as it lands (`poll_refresh`), so a slow site never holds the window.

tl.so.tilo.feeds.Library.stop_refresh.Ar.description: Stops a refresh that is running.

tl.so.tilo.feeds.Library.poll_refresh.Ar.description:
Takes what the device has read so far: each subscription's answer as it lands, and what the
feed says of itself with it. What a refresh brought in is nobody's step of their own, so
landing it says nothing and offers no undo of its own; an article the library already keeps is
not added twice. Landing writes, so it stands here rather than in a call of its own: a run that
calls another action is run twice, and the device's answers are not its to answer twice.

tl.so.tilo.feeds.Library.import_opml.Arg.description:
Subscribes to what an OPML file lists: every address the library does not have yet, in the
folders the file names, made where missing.

tl.so.tilo.feeds.Library.export_opml.Arg.description: The library's subscriptions as an OPML 2.0 file.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.read_list.description:
Reads the place `place` into this window's listing for it: a folder's entries, this device's
trash, or nothing for the places this app keeps itself.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.changed.A.description: Runs when a watched folder changes: reads the folder shown again.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.preview_s.description:
Makes the previews of a few pictures in the folder shown that have none yet, as the window
shows it: a folder of photographs fills with their pictures while the person looks at it,
without the window waiting for every one when the folder is read.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.go.Argume.description: Goes to the place `place`, reading it: a folder, the trash, the recent files or the apps.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.back.Argu.description: Goes back to the place the person came from.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.forward.A.description: Goes forward again to the place the person left.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.up.Argume.description: Goes to the folder above the one shown.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.show.Argu.description:
Shows `path` in this window: the folder itself when it is one, and the folder that holds it with
the entry chosen when it is a file. It is how another app sends a person to a file it made, and
how an agent or a link brings them to one, so the person reads where it stands in its folder.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.extract_i.description:
Extracts the archive at `path` into `folder`, into a folder named after it there: what the
rows that offer a folder to extract into ask.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.move_into.description: Moves the entries the person chose into `folder`, keeping a taken name both.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.drop_into.description:
Moves the entries the person dragged onto the folder `folder`, by their `paths`, as "Move to…"
does, keeping a taken name both. A folder let go on itself, inside itself or on the folder its
entries already stand in moves nothing.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.copy_into.description: Copies the entries the person chose into `folder`, keeping a taken name both.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.put_into..description:
Puts the entries at `paths` into `folder`, moving them or copying them, as the device's own work:
the window shows how far it has got and can stop it. What arrives under a name the folder
already holds lands as “name (2)”, so nothing is replaced.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.poll_tran.description:
Asks how far each transfer under way has got. One that finished leaves the window and the
folder is read again; one that failed stays, saying why, until it is dismissed.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.stop_tran.description: Stops the transfer `transfer`: the entry it was on is taken away, and what it finished stays.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.dismiss_t.description: Takes a transfer that stopped short out of the window.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.send_near.description: Sends the entries the person chose to the nearby device `nearby`, as Nearby Send offers it.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.dismiss_n.description: Dismisses what the window last said went wrong.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.refresh.A.description: Reads the place shown again, so what changed on the disk shows.

choice_labels.format: By the kind of file they are
choice_labels.name: By what they are called

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.sort_by.A.description: Sorts the folder shown by `by`, the way `ascending` says.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.ascending.description: Sorts the folder shown oldest or smallest first, or the other way.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.show_grid.description: Draws the folder as a grid of cards, or as rows.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.choose_vi.description: Draws the folder the way the segment at place `i` says: the list at 0, the grid at 1.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.toggle_hi.description: Shows or hides the names that start with a dot.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.set_zoom..description: Draws the entries at `step`: 0 smaller, 1 regular, 2 larger, as the two keys step it.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.zoom_in.A.description: Draws the entries one step larger.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.zoom_out..description: Draws the entries one step smaller.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.open_entr.description: Opens the entry `e`: a folder in this window, a file in the app that opens its kind.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.find_open.description: Finds the apps that open the entry at `path`, for the person to choose one.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.open_with.description: Opens the entry the person asked to open with in `chosen`, one of the apps offered.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.close_ope.description: Puts away the apps offered for the entry the person asked to open with.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.open_term.description: Opens a terminal in the folder at `folder`.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.compress_.description:
Packs the entry at `path` into a new archive beside it, named after it: `zip` picks a ZIP,
and TAR.ZST otherwise.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.extract_e.description: Extracts the archive at `path` into a new folder beside it, named after it.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.touch_ent.description:
A press on the entry at `path`: a folder opens as a person presses it once, and a file is
read into the inspector beside the list.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.choose.Ar.description: The entries the list reports as chosen, in the order they stand there.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.select_al.description: Chooses every entry the folder shown places: what a press on "Select all" does.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.note_rece.description: Notes that the file `path` was opened, so it stands under Recent.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.new_folde.description: Makes a folder named `name` in the place shown.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.start_new.description: Reads the person's `~/Templates`, so naming a new file can offer them.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.new_from_.description: Copies the template `template` into the place shown under `typed`'s name, or the template's.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.new_file..description: Makes a text file named `name` in the place shown, for the person to fill.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.import_dr.description:
Writes the files a person dropped on the window into the folder shown, each under its own
name; a name the folder already holds is kept both, so nothing is replaced.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.open_driv.description:
Opens the drive `drive` and goes to where it is open, so a removable disk is a place like any
other folder. A drive that still has to open shows as such until the device says where it is.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.rename_en.description: Renames the entry at `path` to `name` in its own folder.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.trash_ent.description: Moves the entries at `paths` to this device's trash.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.restore_e.description: Restores the trashed entry `name` to where it came from.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.delete_pe.description: Removes the entry at `path` for good.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.empty_tra.description: Empties this device's trash: every entry, and the receipt that would put it back.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.carry.Arg.description: Remembers the entries at `paths` as what a paste copies; `cut` makes it a move.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.carry_sel.description: Remembers the entries the person chose as what a paste copies.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.compress_.description:
Packs the entries the person chose into one archive beside them: `zip` picks a ZIP, and TAR.ZST
otherwise. The archive is named after the entry alone, or after its folder when several go in.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.paste.Arg.description:
Pastes what the person carries into the place shown, as the device's own work that says how
far it has got. A name the folder already holds is kept both: what arrives lands as
“name (2)”, so nothing is overwritten.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.free_name.description:
A name `folder` does not hold yet, for an entry that would land as `name`: the name itself, or
“name (2)”, “name (3)” before the extension, so a paste or a drop never replaces a file.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.key_on.Ar.description:
A key pressed on the row `focused`: what Files does with a copy, a cut or a delete over the
entries the person chose, or over that row when it is not among them.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.carry_row.description:
Remembers what a copy from the row at `path` takes: the entries the person chose when that row
is one of them, and the row alone otherwise.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.trash_row.description:
Moves to Trash what a delete from the row at `path` takes: the entries the person chose when
that row is one of them, and the row alone otherwise.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.add_favor.description: Marks the place `place` in the sidebar.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.remove_fa.description: Takes the place `place` out of the sidebar's favorites.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.inspect.A.description:
Reads what the chosen entry is, so the inspector says its size, its kind and its path, and
shows a picture file's picture or a text file's first words.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.name_it.A.description:
Does what the name asked of the person is for: makes the folder or the file, or renames the
entry.

tl.so.tilo.file-explorer.Files.open_app..description: Opens the app `a`, as pressing its row does.

tl.so.tilo.firewall.Firewall.apply_store.description:
Applies the workspace's configuration to this device's firewalld when it does not hold it:
a change another device made, or one taken back, reaches this device's firewall too.

tl.so.tilo.firewall.Firewall.import_devi.description:
Brings in what this device's firewalld holds: the zones, their services and rules, and the
switches. A device whose firewalld does not answer keeps the configuration it has.

tl.so.tilo.firewall.Firewall.stop.Argume.description:
Stops firewalld.

Undo starts it again but cannot take back what reached the machine while it was open, so
this is asked first.

tl.so.tilo.firewall.Firewall.enter_panic.description:
Enters panic mode: all traffic in and out is dropped.

Undo lifts it but cannot restore the connections it cut, so this is asked first.

tl.so.tilo.firewall.Firewall.make_active.description: Makes a zone the active one.

tl.so.tilo.firewall.Firewall.toggle_rule.description: Turns a rule on or off in a zone.

tl.so.tilo.firewall.Firewall.allow_servi.description: Allows a service in a zone, or stops allowing it.

tl.so.tilo.firewall.Firewall.add_rule.Ar.description:
Adds a rule to a zone, or saves the one being edited.

A rule that names no valid port or source is refused, and the form says why.

tl.so.tilo.firewall.Firewall.delete_rule.description: Deletes a rule from a zone.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.choose_.description: Starts choosing a repository's folder, listing this device's home folder.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.open_br.description: Opens the folder the picker shows as a repository.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.unstage.description: Takes one staged file back out of the next commit.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.change_.description:
The key pressed on a file's row: `s` stages it or takes it back out of the next commit, and on
a conflicted file `o` or `t` keeps our side or theirs.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.discard.description: Discards the working tree's edits to one file, or deletes it when it was never tracked.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.unstage.description: Takes every staged change back out of the next commit.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.stage_h.description: Stages one hunk of a file.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.unstage.description: Takes one staged hunk back out of the next commit.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.discard.description: Discards one hunk of a file's working tree edits.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.commit..description: Creates a commit from what is staged.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.resolve.description: Keeps one side of a conflicted file and stages it as resolved.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.create_.description: Creates a branch and switches to it.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.checkou.description: Switches to a branch, asking what becomes of uncommitted work when there is any.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.switch_.description: Answers the switch question by parking the uncommitted work on the stash first.
Answers the switch question by carrying the uncommitted work along.
Switches to `name`, parking the uncommitted work when `stash` says so.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.branch_.description:
The key pressed on a branch's row: `Enter` switches to it, and `Delete` deletes it when it is a
local branch that is not the one checked out.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.save_st.description: Stashes the working tree's changes, with a message.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.apply_s.description: Applies a stash, leaving it in the list.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.create_.description: Makes a new branch at `start` and a working directory of its own.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.pull.Ar.description: Fetches, then fast-forwards the current branch to its upstream.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.push.Ar.description: Pushes the current branch to a like-named branch on a remote.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.run-app.description:
Runs a check this project's host approved, by its id: the host picks the commands, the sources
and the bounds, reports how far it has got, and says what it observed once it ends.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.poll_ch.description: Asks the device how the running check is doing, and keeps what the host reported.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.cancel_.description: Stops the running check; the host ends its commands.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.clear_c.description: Puts the last check's result away.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.read_co.description: Reads a commit's changed files and their diffs when it is opened.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.commit_.description:
The key pressed on a commit's row: `Enter` opens its changed files, and `Backspace` or `Escape`
steps back out of them, leaving the list of commits as it was.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.toggle_.description: Switches how this person reads diffs: one column or two.
Turns syntax colouring on or off for this person.
Shows or hides the whitespace at the end of diff lines for this person.
Wraps long diff lines or lets them run wider than the pane, for this person.

tl.so.tilo.git-client.Repository.asks.Ar.description:
Runs `op` with `ask` and keeps the answer: the repository as it now stands, and the working
tree as the device read it.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.move_curs.description:
The cursor moved to `at`, kept inside the bytes; `extend` keeps where the selection started,
and the window's first row follows it when it leaves the rows shown.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.show.Argu.description: Read the window's rows and the bytes at its cursor from the device again.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.edit.Argu.description: Apply one edit of the bytes: the device checks it and answers the change to keep.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.save.Argu.description: Saves the buffer where it came from, or asks where when it stands nowhere yet.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.save_byte.description:
The bytes as a file the person places with the system's save chooser, which the window
shows.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.rebased.A.description: What was saved is the base: no edit stands against it any more.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.press.Arg.description: The keys pressed on the grid, as the person's keyboard names them.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.chord.Arg.description: The Ctrl chords typed while the bytes have the keyboard.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.moved.Arg.description: The cursor moved to `at`: the rows and the inspector read there.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.type_hex..description:
Type one hexadecimal digit: in overwrite mode the first sets the high nibble and the second
completes the byte; in insert mode each completed byte is spliced in.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.type_asci.description: Type a character into the ASCII column, then advance.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.backspace.description: In insert mode the byte before the cursor goes; in overwrite mode the cursor only steps back.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.delete_at.description: The selection goes, or else the byte under the cursor.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.copy.Argu.description: Copies the selected bytes in the column's form: `50 4e 47 44`, or `PNGD`.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.cut.Argum.description: Copies the selection and deletes it.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.paste.Arg.description: Pastes the clipboard at the selection, or at the cursor, in the focus mode.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.replaced..description: Replaces each span with the same bytes, as one step.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.close_pan.description: Closes the strip under the bar.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.search.Ar.description: Finds `query` in the bytes: a hexadecimal pattern, or text under its rules.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.reveal.Ar.description: Puts the cursor on the match at `index`.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.replace_a.description: Replaces every match the search found with `with`.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.search_ki.description: Reads the search strip's choices: text or hexadecimal, letter case and whole words.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.go_to.Arg.description: Moves the cursor to the offset `query` names.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.pressed.A.description:
A press on the grid: the byte at `at` gets the cursor, the column pressed the focus, and
`"shift"` keeps where the selection started.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.scrolled..description: The wheel or the bar moved the window by `rows`.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.insert_by.description: Inserts `bytes` (hexadecimal, like `de ad be ef`) at `offset`.

tl.so.tilo.hex-editor.Document.overwrite.description: Replaces the bytes at `offset` with `bytes` (hexadecimal), never growing the file.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Account.check_now.Argume.description:
Asks the account's server for its mail now: what a person presses when the window says the
server could not be reached, or that what it fetched could not be saved. The account says
how it stands once it answers.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Account.search_server.Ar.description:
Asks the account's server to search its mail for `text`: what finds mail the workspace does
not hold, and mail in folders it does not sync. What it finds comes in as the account's
conversations, as a fetch's mail does, so it is read and searched here from then on.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Account.new_message.Argu.description: Starts a message from the account.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Account.empty_trash.Argu.description:
Deletes every conversation in the account's trash from the mailbox and its server for good,
each as `purge` does. A view offers this behind a confirmation, as nothing undoes it.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Account.mark_all_read.Ar.description: Marks every conversation of the account read.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mailbox.older_messages.A.description:
Asks the account's server for the messages older than the oldest this workspace holds in the
mailbox, so a folder longer than one page can be read back to its first message. They come in
as new mail does, and the mailbox stops offering them once its first message is here. A
mailbox whose server holds nothing older answers nothing, as a list reads to its end asking
whether a page is there.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.reply.Arguments.description:
Answers the conversation's newest message, to whoever wrote it, quoting it under what is
written.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.reply_all.Argumen.description: Answers the conversation's newest message, to everyone it went to, quoting it.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.forward.Arguments.description:
Sends the conversation's newest message on, with its sender, what it says and the files it
came with.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.archive.Arguments.description: Archives the conversation: its messages leave the inbox.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.to_inbox.Argument.description:
Moves the conversation back to the inbox, and unmutes it: what a person brings back is what
they want to see again.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.move_to.Arguments.description: Moves the conversation to another mailbox of its account.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.delete.Arguments.description: Deletes the conversation: its messages go to the trash.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.junk.Arguments.description:
Marks the conversation as junk: its messages leave the inbox for the account's junk
mailbox, and what comes of it again stays there.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.purge.Arguments.description:
Deletes the conversation's trashed messages for good, from its server too, and the
conversation with them when no message of it is left. This is the one deletion there is no
trash to take back from: what is deleted for good is gone from the server, and this app's
record of it leaves once the server says it is.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.snooze.Arguments.description:
Puts the conversation away until a moment: it leaves the inbox, and comes back once that
moment has come, with no window open. The moment is a field, so it survives closing and
reopening, and an agent snoozes the same way.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.snooze_an_hour.Ar.description: Puts the conversation away for an hour, the snooze people reach for most.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.snooze_until_tomo.description: Puts the conversation away until tomorrow morning, at nine, in the person's own zone.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.unsnooze.Argument.description: Brings a snoozed conversation back now, whatever its moment was: it is in the inbox again.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.label.Arguments.description:
Gives the conversation a label, or takes one away: `on` says which. The label joins the
workspace's labels the first time it is given, so it has a filter of its own from then on.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.mute.Arguments.description:
Mutes the conversation, or unmutes it: a muted one stays out of the inbox until it is
brought back, whatever its new messages do.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.mark_read.Argumen.description: Marks the conversation read, or unread again.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.announce.Argument.description:
Tells everyone who reads the conversation that mail came to it: who wrote, what it is
called, and which account it came to while the workspace reads several of them, opening the
conversation. It is run once for each arrival, on the device that governs the workspace, so
each person is told once however many of their devices are open.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Thread.answer.Arguments.description:
Answers the conversation with what was typed: the message goes to whoever wrote its newest,
as a reply to it, quoted.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.show_pictures.Ar.description:
Brings in the pictures the sender's page names: each read from where it stands and kept in the
workspace's content, so the message shows them as it was written. What a workspace's rules or
its network refuse is left out, and the message reads without it.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.links.Arguments.description:
The links a message says, each once, in the order it says them: what its formatted part links
to, or the web and mail addresses its words carry. A person reads them, copies one, or an
agent asks what a message would have one open.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.open_link.Argume.description:
Opens one of a message's links in the app that opens links of its scheme, as pressing a link
does: the Browser for a web address. A message opens only a link it says.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.copy_link.Argume.description: Copies one of a message's links, the address alone, as a person hands it to someone.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.export_markdown..description: The message as a Markdown file: what a person exports to read it, or keep it, elsewhere.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.export_json.Argu.description: The message as a JSON file: what a script or an agent reads its record from.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.export_eml.Argum.description:
The message as an `.eml` file, which every mail program opens. A message taken in from outside
an account's server is exported as it was sent; one its server holds is written from what the
workspace keeps of it.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.reply_to.Argumen.description: Answers one message of the conversation, to whoever wrote it, quoting it.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.reply_all_to.Arg.description: Answers one message of the conversation, to everyone it went to but the person answering.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.forward_message..description:
Sends one message of the conversation on, with its sender, when and what it says, and the
files it came with.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.attachment.Argum.description:
One file the message came with, as a file of its own: what Save puts in Files, and what an
agent reads or hands another app.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Message.open_attachment..description:
Opens a file a message came with in the app that opens its kind, as Files opens one: the file
reaches that app as the same content both read, never as a path neither has.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Draft.attach.Arguments.description:
Takes a file along with the message: one the person picks, or one an agent hands over. A
message takes up to sixteen files of up to 32 MB each, as mail servers take them.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Draft.detach.Arguments.description: Leaves a file the message was to take along behind.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Draft.cancel_later.Argum.description:
Brings a message back to the outbox: it was sent to go at a moment still to come, and it is
a draft again, whatever the moment.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Draft.send_later.Argumen.description:
Sends the message at a moment instead of now: it waits in the outbox until then, as the
person's hold makes a message wait, and goes with no window open. Until it goes it can be
taken back, and bringing it back leaves it a draft.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Draft.send_in_the_mornin.description:
Sends the message at nine tomorrow, the moment people reach for most when they write in the
evening and do not want it to arrive then.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Draft.send_from.Argument.description: Sends the message from another workspace account.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Draft.send_as.Arguments.description:
Sends the message as another of its account's names or addresses, `Name <address>`: what a
person writing as a role rather than as themselves chooses. Empty sends as the account's own.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Draft.retry.Arguments.description:
Sends a message the account's server refused again, from where it stands: the version that
failed did not leave, so it goes once. A message whose outcome nobody knows is not tried
again, since it may have gone.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Draft.send.Arguments.description:
Sends the message from its account. It leaves the system, so it goes once, and waits in the
outbox until the server took it; it is held back for the person's hold first, so they can
take it back. The effect is an argument the action records, so the wait survives a window
closing and an agent takes it back the same way. Whoever is asked to let it go reads who it
goes to and what it says.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Draft.undo_send.Argument.description:
Takes back a message that was sent and has not gone yet: it never leaves, and the message is
a draft again, as it was. Once it went it cannot be taken back.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.trust_sender.Argume.description: Shows the pictures of every message `address` sends, from now on and in what is already here.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.distrust_sender.Arg.description: Asks again before showing what `address` sends.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.set_hold.Arguments.description:
Sets how many seconds a sent message waits before it goes, so it can be taken back: no wait
at all at zero.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.new_draft.Arguments.description:
Starts a message. A message is written before the workspace has an account to send it from:
it waits in Drafts, and goes once the person adds one.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.open_link.Arguments.description:
Opens a `mailto:` link: a message to whom it names, in Drafts, for the person to read and
send. A link that names no address opens nothing, as it names nobody to write to. The
host publishes this as the system's `open-link` on the mailbox, which is what a shell hands
a link to.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.draft_message.Argum.description:
Writes a message for the person to read and send: to whom, its subject and what it says,
answering `in_reply_to` (a Message-ID) when it names one. Every call makes a draft of its own
beside the others; nothing is written over and nothing is sent. Where an agent drafts a
message, the person finds it in Drafts and sends it.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.prepare_calendar_in.description:
Starts a message inviting `to` to an event, its invitation (`calendar_ics`, iCalendar) carried
beside what it says: what Calendar hands Mail for each guest it invites. Nothing is sent; the
person reads it, and sends it.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.deliver_message.Arg.description:
Takes in a message that reached the workspace from outside its accounts' servers: one moved
in from another mail program (`tilo migrate`), or handed over through the API. It is kept
with the mail held outside the accounts, in the conversation it belongs to (`conversation`,
the Message-ID the conversation began with) and the folder it was in, read or not. `from` is
the sender as a header writes it (`Ada Lovelace <ada@example.com>`), and `original` the
content reference of the message as it was sent, less its large parts: `parts` says where
each of those stands in it and which pieces of content it is in, one JSON text each
(`{"at": 120, "size": 4096, "pieces": ["tilo.content:…"]}`). `attachments` are the files it
carries, each content the workspace holds. A message already held under its Message-ID is
answered as it is, so delivering it again keeps it once.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.open_message_file.A.description:
Opens a message kept as a file a mail program writes (`.eml`, a single message of an mbox, or
Apple Mail's `.emlx`): its headers are read, and it is kept with the mail held outside the
accounts, read, in the inbox. The same file opened again is the message already kept.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.rename_label.Argume.description: Renames one of the workspace's labels, all the conversations that carry it with it.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.delete_label.Argume.description: Deletes one of the workspace's labels, and takes it off every conversation that carries it.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.discard.Arguments.description: Throws a message being written away.

tl.so.tilo.mail.Mail.save_to_drafts.Argu.description:
Keeps the message in the account's server Drafts folder as it is written now, so another
mail client of the account sees it there too. What the server says comes back with the
account's next mail, and the server's Drafts are read like its other folders.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.forget_found.Argum.description: Marks every place a search found as no longer found, and forgets the ones nobody kept.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.remember.Arguments.description: Remembers a search, newest first, at most eight.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.take_in.Arguments.description: Adds the places a search found to the map, keeping one the person already kept as theirs.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.accept_places.Argu.description: Takes the places another app or an agent found into the map.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.search.Arguments.description: Searches the map for the places `query` names, and shows what it found.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.clear_search.Argum.description: Takes the last search's results away.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.clear_recents.Argu.description: Takes the searches the person made away.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.open_place.Argumen.description: Shows the place `place` on the map: the map opens on it.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.show_point.Argumen.description: Shows a point on the map, as a link or another app names it.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.locate.Arguments.description: Finds the device and shows where it is.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.zoom_map.Arguments.description: Zooms the map a level in or out: a level of imagery is the camera's zoom doubled or halved.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.set_transit_time.A.description: When public transport journeys leave, or when they must arrive.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.directions.Argumen.description: Plans a route between two places the person named, by the mode directions travel, and shows it.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.plan_transit.Argum.description: Finds the journeys public transport offers between two places.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.accept_route.Argum.description: Takes the routes directions found as the map's, and shows the first.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.another_route.Argu.description: Shows the next route directions offered for the same journey.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.fit_map.Arguments.description: Shows everything the map holds: the route it draws, or every place it knows.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.accept_transit.Arg.description: Takes the journeys public transport offered as the map's, and shows the first.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.another_journey.Ar.description: Shows the next journey public transport offered.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.start_navigation.A.description: Follows the route the map draws: the live card says the turn ahead.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.find_nearby.Argume.description: Shows what stands around the map, from OpenStreetMap.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.open_poi.Arguments.description: Shows a point of interest the map found, and opens the map on it.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.toggle_traffic.Arg.description: Shows the traffic layer on the map, or takes it away.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.download_view.Argu.description:
Saves what the map shows for offline use: the box on screen and the zoom levels whose tiles it
keeps. A caller names the box itself where it has one (a press, an agent): without one it is
the place the map is centred on.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.download_place.Arg.description:
Saves the area around the place `query` names for offline use, with the zoom levels whose tiles
it keeps.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.keep_area.Argument.description:
Keeps `area` on this device, replacing an area of the same footprint or name, and starts its
download.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.save_area.Argument.description:
Starts keeping `area`'s tiles, as a job whose record says how far it has come. A tile already
kept is not fetched again, so this also continues a stopped area.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.area_saved.Argumen.description: What an area's download ended with: what it kept, or that the person stopped it.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.stop_offline_area..description: Stops an area's download: the tiles kept so far stay available offline.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.continue_offline_a.description: Starts a stopped area's download again, keeping what it already has.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.delete_offline_are.description: Takes an area this device saved away, and the tiles of it no other kept area needs.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.clear_offline_area.description: Takes every area this device saved away.

tl.so.tilo.maps.Atlas.open_link.Argument.description: Opens a `geo:` link: its search (`geo:0,0?q=cafe`), else its point (`geo:52.52,13.40`).

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.review_item.description:
The review found the item `key`: it is kept as found, and one found before keeps whether a
person chose it; a new one is chosen as `chosen` says.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.forget_item.description: A fresh review no longer found the items whose keys are not in `keep`: they go.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.choose.Argu.description:
Chooses an item of `g` to be brought in, or leaves it out: the device that holds the data
keeps the choice, and the migration follows it there, as `choose_keys`.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.choose_keys.description:
The device chose the items whose keys are `keys`, or left them out; with `only`, every other
item is left out.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.begun.Argum.description:
The device began the run `run`, or resumed it: it is running. A new run starts its counts
again; a resumed one goes on counting.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.landed.Argu.description:
The run `run` brought in the items `keys`: `count` things of `kind`, and found `already` of
them in the workspace before.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.ended.Argum.description: The run ended as `state`: stopped, failed with `failure`, or complete.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.forgot_run..description:
The device took out of the workspace what the run `run` brought in: its keys are no longer
landed and the run is gone. Undoing the current run puts the migration back to reviewed.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.refused.Arg.description:
The device refused a step asked of `g`, for `why`: nothing chosen to bring in, a source it
cannot read, a run it cannot take back.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.review.Argu.description: Read `g`'s source again: what it holds now is what there is to choose from.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.start.Argum.description:
Bring in what is chosen of `g`'s source: the device that holds the data runs it as one run,
and the migration follows it there, as `begun`, `landed` and `ended`. The action lasts as long
as the run, and stopping it stops the run.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.stop.Argume.description: Stop `g`'s run after the item it is on: what it brought stays, and starting again resumes it.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migration.undo.Argume.description: Take what the run `r` brought in back out of the workspace.

tl.so.tilo.migrate.Migrations.reviewed.A.description:
The device that reviewed `source` lists it: the migration for that source on that device,
made the first time, with its title and the handle the review read. What it could not read
is cleared; the review's items follow with `review_item`.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.session.Argumen.description:
The session this app plays through: the one it has, or one made now. It is kept both in
`playing`, which a view reads, and in `sessions`, so the record is a resource of its own.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.open_audio_file.description:
Opens an audio file: the file a person picked, or one Files handed over, and plays it. The
song it already made opens instead of a second copy, so its place in history stays one.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.follow_stream.A.description:
Keeps the session's source the song's own address, so the live card and another device play
the one the catalogue last answered with.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.open_link.Argum.description:
Opens a `music://` link: the song it names plays, and the album, artist or playlist it names
opens on its page. A shell hands a link here whether or not a window of Music is open, and what
this returns opens in the window; a link this library holds nothing for shows the library.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.add_to_queue.Ar.description: Adds a song to what follows.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.play_next.Argum.description: Queues a song right after what plays.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.lyrics_now.Argu.description: Asks for the words of what plays, keeping the session it asks for.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.hide_rec.Argume.description: Hides a song from the suggestions. History can undo it, and the taste page brings it back.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.restore_rec.Arg.description: Brings a hidden song back into the suggestions.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.search.Argument.description: Asks the catalogue for the songs, albums, artists and playlists a query finds.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.refresh.Argumen.description: Asks the catalogue for its home page.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.open_suggestion.description: Does what a suggestion on the home page names.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.lyrics_of.Argum.description: Asks for what plays to be sung, into the song's own record.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.note_failure.Ar.description:
Says why the player stopped, and where, so the notice names the place and continues there.
A stream that stopped partway is first asked for again by itself, once: a source that drops
a connection or an address that expired plays on without the person doing anything.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.retry_stream.Ar.description:
Asks the catalogue for the song's address again and plays it on from where it stopped: a
stream its source stopped serving partway through, or one whose signed address expired,
continues from that place rather than beginning again.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.new_mixtape.Arg.description:
Makes a playlist of the person's own: at Spotify too, when it is their catalogue and their
Spotify is connected, so the playlist plays there as it does here.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.set_catalogue.A.description: Chooses which catalogue the app asks.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.connect_spotify.description: Connects the person's Spotify: the page they sign in on is shown in the Spotify section.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.finish_spotify..description: Takes the sign-in the person gave on Spotify's page.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.spotify_devices.description: Reads the places Spotify plays on.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.transfer_playba.description: Moves what plays to `d`, from the beginning.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.remote_play.Arg.description: Plays `uri` on Spotify, where it plays: empty plays what was playing.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.remote_previous.description: Plays what played before on Spotify.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.spotify_now.Arg.description: Reads what plays on Spotify now.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.spotify_queue.A.description: Reads what plays next on Spotify: its own queue, which is shown here and never edited here.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.queue_on_spotif.description: Puts a song after what plays on Spotify.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.spotify_more.Ar.description: Asks Spotify for one more page of what the person keeps there.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.update_taste.Ar.description: Turns one of the recommendations' switches.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.dismiss_artist..description: Leaves an artist out of the recommendations, or brings them back.

tl.so.tilo.music.Library.prefer_artist.A.description: Asks for more of an artist.

tl.so.tilo.music.queue_moved.Arguments.description: Moves the dragged row where it was dropped: the two ids its reorder carries.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.insert-block.Argum.description: Put a paragraph before the one the address names.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.delete-block.Argum.description: Remove the paragraph the address names, and the paragraphs it holds.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.$scenario.Argument.description: The data the app's shots and demos start from is written.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.new_child.Argument.description:
Starts a note inside `n`'s own, after the notes it already holds, titled `words` when the
caller knows them already (a `/page` in one of `n`'s blocks names the page it makes with the
words that stood there): the note the window has open too, so a person writing one starts the
note it stands under without finding its row. It is `n`'s action, so the window offers it for
the note it shows and its row offers it.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.indent.Arguments.description:
Puts a note under the note it stands over, with the notes under it, as `Tab` does in the
tree; with none named, it goes under the note above it.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.outdent.Arguments.description:
Puts a note beside the note it stands in, just after it and the notes under it, as
`Shift-Tab` does in the tree.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.move_up.Arguments.description:
Puts a note just over the note above it, with the notes under it, as `Alt-Up` does in the
tree; with none named, over the note just above it.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.move_down.Argument.description:
Puts a note just under the note below it and the notes under that one, with its own notes
after it, as `Alt-Down` does in the tree.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.add_text.Arguments.description:
Writes `text` (Markdown) at the end of a note, as paragraphs of its own under what it says
already: a line, a list or a paragraph added to it, never running on into its last paragraph.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.tag.Arguments.description:
Gives a note the tag `tag`, and lists the tag in the notebook when it lists none of that
name yet: a name is how a person, an agent and a script know a tag.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.untag.Arguments.description:
Takes the tag `tag` off a note. The notebook keeps listing it, so a person finds it again
for another note; deleting it from the notebook takes it off every note.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.find_text.Argument.description:
Finds the words `text` in one note, the case of their letters aside, and answers each
paragraph holding them with its place in the note and its words: what the window's find bar
shows, reachable by an agent or the palette that knows the note but not where in it to look.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.react.Arguments.description:
Adds your reaction with an emoji to a note, or takes it back when you had reacted with it: a
press on one of its pills, or the pick of the one its add button opened.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.insert_image.Argum.description:
Puts a picture in a note, where its words end, described by `alt` for a reader who cannot see
it: the person picks the file, and the note keeps the address of its content rather than the
picture, and the name it came in as. Nothing in `alt` can end the Markdown a picture is
written with, so a description holding brackets or parentheses still reads as one picture.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.place_image.Argume.description:
Writes a picture in where the person is writing: the picture the person chose is handed to
the editor, which puts it at the caret, as its own `/image` command does. The note keeps the
address of its bytes and the name it came in as, which an export writes beside the note.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.keep_image.Argumen.description:
Keeps a picture the editor wrote into a note where the person pasted or dropped it: the note
holds the address of its bytes, and the name it came in as, which an export writes beside it.
`picture` is the editor's word of it: its name, then the address of its content. A picture
already named by the note — one the person chose with `place_image` — keeps that name.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.export_markdown.Ar.description:
A note as Markdown: its title, then its body, each picture it shows written beside it as
`<note>/images/<name>`, a path another reader of the file follows and this app reads again
as the address of the picture's bytes.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Note.export_note.Argume.description:
A note as a file: its Markdown, and the pictures it shows beside it. A note that shows a
picture is one zip — `Q3 plan.md` and `Q3 plan/images/fox.png` — because Markdown reaches a
picture by a path and by nothing else; a note of words alone is that Markdown itself.

field.description: The name of the field to set.

tl.so.tilo.notes.Notebook.edit-text.Argu.description: A bound control changes the field it shows.
