tl.so.tilo.totp.Account.rename_account.A.description:
Renames an account's service: what a person changing the name it shows did. The codes'
settings come from the form, which read them when it opened: an action never reads the
vault, so what it keeps is what the window showed the person.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Account.relabel_account..description:
Changes who an account signs in as: what a person changing its name did. Its codes' settings
come from the form, as a rename's do.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Account.recolor_account..description: Gives an account a colour of its own: what a person recolouring it did.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Account.recode_account.A.description:
Changes how an account makes its codes, and its key with them: what a person changing the
algorithm, the digits, the period or the key did.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Account.update_account.A.description:
Changes what an account says, and its key and how its codes are made. A key left out keeps
the one the vault holds: the service's key never leaves it, so changing an account's details
can never show it.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Account.copy_code.Argume.description:
Copies an account's current code to the clipboard, and says so: the person asked for it, and
a window that shows nothing would leave them guessing whether it worked.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Vault.add_account.Argume.description:
Starts an account from what the person typed, or what a setup link said: what an agent, a
script or the form asks. The vault keeps the seed; the account keeps the words.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Vault.import_uri.Argumen.description: Adds the account a setup link names: what the QR scan and the paste field both end in.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Vault.scan_picture.Argum.description:
Reads the account a picture's QR code names, and keeps its key in the vault for the form to
show: nothing is added until the person reads what the picture said and saves it.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Vault.add_pending.Argume.description: Adds the account the picture read, with the key the vault already holds for it.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Vault.drop_pending.Argum.description: Lets the picture's account go: the key the vault kept for it is forgotten too.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Vault.move_up.Arguments.description: Moves an account one place up the list.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Vault.move_down.Argument.description: Moves an account one place down the list.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Vault.delete_account.Arg.description: Deletes an account and the key the vault kept for it.

tl.so.tilo.totp.Vault.save_account.Argum.description:
Saves the form: starts the account, or changes the one it was opened over, answering whether
it saved. A refusal says why in the bar and leaves the form open with what was typed, so a
window only leaves the form when this answered that it saved.

tl.so.tilo.tube.Video.watch_later.Argume.description:
Puts the video on the workspace's watch queue, or takes it off. A video put on it goes after
the ones already waiting, so the queue plays in the order people added to it.

tl.so.tilo.tube.Video.play.Arguments.description:
Plays the video, whether or not it was played before: the session takes it as its one item,
so the player, the live card and the media keys all act on it, and it continues where the
person left it.

tl.so.tilo.tube.Video.resume.Arguments.description: Plays the video from where the person left off, when they did not finish it.

tl.so.tilo.tube.Video.play_at_quality.Ar.description:
Plays the video at `quality`, from where it stands: the player's own quality menu, which asks
the service for a stream of that picture. The session keeps the item and the place it stood
at, so the picture changes without the playhead moving; the address YouTube answers with is
the one the player opens next, and `progress` writes it into the session's item.

tl.so.tilo.tube.Video.progress.Arguments.description:
Records how far into the video the person is, and that they watched it now: it moves to the
front of the history, and asks the service for the address its bytes play from when that is
not known yet. Starting a video, resuming it and moving the playhead as it plays are one
action, so a video has one place it is played from.

tl.so.tilo.tube.Video.skip_segment.Argum.description:
Skips the SponsorBlock segment the video plays into, at `at` (a share of its length), when the
person skips segments: the playhead moves to the segment's end, so a sponsor read or an outro
is never watched. The player reports where it got to as it plays, so this is what makes a
marked segment skip on its own.

tl.so.tilo.tube.Video.forget.Arguments.description: Takes one video out of the person's own history.

tl.so.tilo.tube.Video.retry_playback.Arg.description:
Asks the service for where the video's bytes play from again, after the player could not show
them: the address the client holds is the service's alone to write, and the answer it gives
now is what the player opens. The session moves to where the stream stopped, so the fresh
address continues there.

tl.so.tilo.tube.Video.refresh_comments.A.description: Asks the service for the video's comments again, for what people said since the page opened.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.play_queue.Argum.description:
Plays the queue from its oldest video: what was put on it first plays first, and the rest
follow in that order, so autoplay goes on down the queue.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.session.Argument.description:
The session this app plays through: the one it has, or one made now. It is kept both in
`playing`, which a view reads, and in `sessions`, so the record is a resource of its own.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.play_items.Argum.description:
Plays `videos` in the session, beginning with `at`'s place: what plays and what follows, so
a shared next, the live card and another device move through the same list. The video at
`at` continues where it was left.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.autoplay_next.Ar.description:
When the video reaches its end and the person asked for the next one, the session moves on to
what follows it: the queue's next video is watched now, so its place in the history is kept
and its bytes are asked for when the service has not answered with them yet.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.delete_history.A.description:
Deletes the person's own watch history, and the entries carried from before it recorded
members, which this history shows them; nobody else's.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.set_autoplay.Arg.description:
Each of these keeps one of the person's own playback preferences: the record is theirs, made
the first time they set one, and every other member reads their own.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.set_quality.Argu.description: The tallest picture the person wants, as YouTube names it; `auto` takes the best that fits.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.set_sponsorblock.description: Whether the player skips the segments SponsorBlock marks, as they play.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.set_dearrow.Argu.description: Whether a video shows the community's title and picture where DeArrow has them.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.set_dislikes.Arg.description: Whether a video shows how many people disliked it, as Return YouTube Dislike estimates it.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.set_comments.Arg.description: Whether a video's page shows its comments.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.set_speed.Argume.description: How fast the person watches: every video here starts at this speed, on every device.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.pair_device.Argu.description:
Pairs a Grayjay device from the invite its Sync screen shows. The invite carries where the
device answers and the one-time code that opens the pairing; the device is recorded waiting
for the person's approval, which is what lets it read and write anything here.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.approve_device.A.description: Approves a device that paired: Grayjay shows the same fingerprint on both ends.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.revoke_device.Ar.description: Revokes a device: its key can no longer read or write anything here.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.sync_devices.Arg.description:
Exchanges with every approved device now: reads the subscriptions and watch history Grayjay
holds, and sends this client's subscriptions that way.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.auto_sync.Argume.description:
The approved devices are exchanged with on the timer, as Grayjay's own app does while it is
open, so what either app adds reaches the other without anyone pressing. Nothing runs until
a person has synced once by hand.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.poll_grayjay.Arg.description:
Follows the Grayjay operation under way, once a second, so its end reaches the window
without anyone asking by hand.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.keep_paired.Argu.description:
Keeps the device a pairing made, waiting for the person's approval: the fingerprint beside
it is what Grayjay shows on the other end.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.keep_exchange.Ar.description:
Keeps what an exchange came to: how each device stands, the subscriptions the other apps
hold, and the videos they watched.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.search.Arguments.description:
Searches YouTube: the service answers with channels, playlists and videos, written where the
search view lists them. The answer arrives through the platform's network, never the app's.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.filter_search.Ar.description:
Narrows the search to the kinds the person chose: `all`, `video`, `channel` or `playlist`.
What the service found is kept, and the page shows the kind chosen alone, as the old chips
did; asking again is the search field's, which carries the kind with it.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.filter_length.Ar.description: Narrows the search to how long its videos run: `any`, `short`, `medium` or `long`.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.filter_published.description:
Narrows the search to how recent its results are: `any`, `hour`, `today`, `week`, `month` or
`year`.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.end_search.Argum.description:
Leaves the search the feed is showing for the place the person chose: the results stay where
the service wrote them (found again by the query that found them), and the client shows the
place chosen.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.refresh_feed.Arg.description:
Asks the service for the newest videos of each subscribed channel: what the subscriptions feed
shows.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.load_trending.Ar.description: Asks the service for the videos it lists as trending.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.open_link.Argume.description:
Opens a link of the scheme this client claims: the video (`tube:watch?v=<key>`), channel
(`tube:channel?key=<key>`) or playlist (`tube:playlist?key=<key>`) it names, or the search it
asks for (`tube:search?q=<query>`). A shell hands a link here whether or not a window of the
client is open, and what this returns opens in the window. The host publishes it as the
system's `open-link` on the client's root, which is what a shell hands a link to.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.like_comment.Arg.description:
Likes a comment, or takes the like back: the person's own, kept with the workspace, since
YouTube lets no app act as them.

tl.so.tilo.tube.YouTube.play_again.Argum.description: Plays the video a history entry names, from where the person left off.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.typeset.description: Typesets the document, as the window and the background do.
Typesets the document when its source moved past the last typeset.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.take_pr.description: Lays the problems a typeset reported over the ones the document held, blocking ones first.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.take_pa.description:
Lays the typeset pages over the ones the document held: a page that draws what it drew keeps
its picture, and one that draws something else is drawn again.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.read_ou.description: Reads the document's headings from its source's syntax.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.draw_pa.description: Draws one page at `width` pixels wide, and its thumbnail.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.draw_ne.description:
Draws the next page the window's width asks for, one a second: a long document fills in page by
page, without anyone waiting for it.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.side_by.description: Shows the source beside the page.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.problem.description: Shows what the typesetter found, or goes back to the page.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.outline.description: Shows the document's headings, or goes back to the page.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.zoom_in.description: Draws the pages a step wider.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.zoom_ou.description: Draws the pages a step narrower.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.fit_wid.description: Draws the pages as wide as the room they are shown in.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.turn_to.description: Turns to a page, so the person comes back to it.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.go_to_p.description: Goes to the place a problem names.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.go_to_h.description: Goes to the line a heading stands on.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.go_to.A.description: Puts the caret at `line`:`column` and shows it, counting each ask so the same place shows again.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.save_fi.description: The document as the file it is saved as, marked as written.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.export_.description: The PDF the last typeset wrote, as the file a person saves.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.copy_se.description: Copies the words a person selected on a page.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.copy_pa.description: Copies all of a page's words.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.page_te.description: All of a page's words, as the typesetter read them.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.selecti.description: The words of a page inside the box from `start` to `end`.

tl.so.tilo.typst-editor.Document.page_wo.description: The placed glyphs of one page, as the typesetter read them.

tl.so.tilo.video.Library.open_video.Argu.description:
Opens a video file: the file a person picked, or one Files handed over, and plays it where it
was left. The clip it already made opens instead of a second copy, so its place in history
stays one.

tl.so.tilo.video.Library.delete_playlist.description: Deletes a playlist and the entries that name it.

tl.so.tilo.video.Library.add_bookmark.Ar.description: Bookmarks the moment `at` of `c`, with `text` when the person wrote something.

tl.so.tilo.video.Library.open_dropped.Ar.description:
Opens the videos a person dropped on the window: each file becomes its clip, and the first
plays in the shared session.

tl.so.tilo.video.Library.session.Argumen.description:
The session this app plays through: the one it has, or one made now. It is kept both in
`playing`, which a view reads, and in `sessions`, so the record is a resource of its own.

tl.so.tilo.video.Library.play_clip.Argum.description:
Plays `c` in the shared session, from where it was left (the beginning the first time):
what the window's Play button, the palette and an agent's `play` run. The place is the
shared session's own record, so the video continues on this device or another.

tl.so.tilo.video.Library.restart_clip.Ar.description: Plays `c` from its beginning, as a person who watched it before chooses.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Media.set_title_.description: One style of a title's lines, drawn again as it changes.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Media.set_align..description: Sets where a title's lines sit in its box.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Track.reset_mix..description: Puts a track back at unity and the centre.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.set_speed.A.description: Sets the rate a clip plays at: 2 twice as fast and half as long, 0.5 in slow motion.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.set_look.Ar.description:
Sets one look of the clip, and draws the frame the preview shows again, so an edit is seen
as it is made rather than at the next move of the playhead.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.set_anchor..description:
Moves the point a clip's scaling and turning go around: a corner, an edge or the middle,
which is where a picture is pinned when it is made half the frame, turned or grown.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.set_curve.A.description:
Sets one channel's tone curve from the points a person shaped, applied to the picture at
once.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.reset_curve.description: Puts one channel's curve back to the straight line: the picture as the grade alone leaves it.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.set_curve_m.description: How much of the curve the picture takes: 0 bypasses it entirely, 1 is the curve as drawn.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.set_mask.Ar.description: Sets which shape limits where a clip shows: `off`, `rect` or `ellipse`.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.fill_frame..description:
Fills the frame with the picture as it comes: every crop, scaling, turn and move taken
back, so the source's own aspect-fit fills as much of the frame as it can.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.fit_mask.Ar.description:
Fits the clip's mask over the picture as the frame shows it: the aspect-fit the source
takes, then its crop, its scaling, its turn and its move, so a mask cuts out the picture
rather than a box of guessed size.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.invert_mask.description: Keeps the inside of the clip's mask, or the outside of it.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.set_transit.description: Sets the incoming transition and how long it runs.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.set_reverse.description: Plays the clip's source backwards, or forwards again, and draws the frame it holds now.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.key_at.Argu.description:
Sets a key of `param` at `at` (timeline seconds), at the value the field holds now: the value
a curve changes from, as the inspection shows it.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.key_colour..description: Sets the colour the key removes to one of the usual screens.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.thumb_frame.description: One frame of a source at `at` seconds in it, kept as a filmstrip picture.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.set_effect..description: How strongly one effect of the clip applies, applied to the picture at once.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.move_effect.description:
Moves an effect up or down the clip's stack: the order decides what the picture goes through
first.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Clip.clear_effec.description: Takes every effect off a clip.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Marker.rename_ma.description:
Renames a mark. A name of nothing is refused: a mark nobody can find in the list is not a
marker.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.restore_.description: Makes the clip `c` keeps on `track`, of `media`, at `start`, with its keys and effects.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.split_at.description: Cuts a clip in two at `at`, each half keeping the source its own part shows.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.shifted..description: Moves `c` (and its linked sound with it) to `start`, refusing an overlap.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.absorb.A.description:
Asks the device what a file is, adds it as a source and draws its swatch and waveform. What
the device said when it could not be added, or empty when it was: a batch names each file
that did not arrive and why, so a person knows what to do about it.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.adopt_pr.description:
Writes what the device read of a source onto it, as the engine said it: what it is, how long
it runs, its size and rate, and whether it carries sound. An action is handed the engine's
words rather than the decoded `Probed`, which is a value no resource holds.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.refresh_.description:
Checks that a source's bytes are here: reads what they are again, draws its swatch and
waveform, and marks it not on this device when the engine cannot reach them.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.relink.A.description:
Points a source at a file the person chose: the clips are cuts of the source, so they keep
it, and the source reads what its new file says.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.mark_mis.description: Says the source's bytes are not on this device, and why the engine could not read them.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.draw_sti.description: The frame the preview shows at `at`, drawn by the engine.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.begin_re.description: Starts the render a person saves.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.import_f.description:
Adds every file a person chose or dropped as a source, and says which files did not arrive
and what the device said of each.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.save_pro.description:
The cut as a file a person keeps: its sources and their places, where they stand on their own
device.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.export_f.description: The cut as a film: what an export made.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.place.Ar.description: Places `m` on `track` at `at`, in the first place it fits.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.place_me.description: Places the bin's source on the first track of its form, at `at`.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.commit_d.description:
What a drag of the timeline committed: a clip moved or trimmed. A clip moved among `with`, the
clips chosen, moves them all.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.move_to..description:
Moves a clip to `start`, as a drag on the timeline lands it, and every other clip among `with`,
the clips chosen, by as much. A clip moved alone goes onto the track `track` names when that is
another track of its kind, unlocked, with room for it there.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.trim_to..description:
Trims a clip to start at `start` and last `length`, as a drag on its edge on the timeline
lands it: a moved start trims its head, else its tail.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.move_mar.description: Moves a marker to `at`, on the frame nearest it.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.moved.Ar.description:
Moves the clips `cs`, and the sound linked to them, by `by` seconds together, refusing an
overlap with a clip that stays.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.split_cl.description: Cuts the clip at the playhead in two.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.cut_at.A.description: Cuts every clip the playhead stands on.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.remove_c.description: Deletes the clips, and the sound linked to them with them.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.ripple_d.description: Deletes the clips and closes the gap each leaves behind it on its track.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.nudge.Ar.description: Slips the clips along the timeline by frames.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.trim_sta.description: Trims the start of each clip the playhead stands in to the playhead.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.trim_end.description: Trims the end of each clip the playhead stands in to the playhead.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.copy_cli.description: Puts the clips, with their looks, keys and effects, on the person's clipboard.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.cut_clip.description: Puts the clips on the person's clipboard and takes them out of the cut.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.paste_tr.description:
The track a pasted clip goes on: the one it came from while it is in this cut and open, else
the first open one of its form, else a new one.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.paste_cl.description:
Places copied clips from `at`, the earliest there and the rest keeping their distance from
it; clips linked to each other stay linked, to each other alone.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.duplicat.description: Puts a copy of the clips right after them, on the same tracks.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.trim_tra.description:
Brings every track down by the same number of decibels, keeping the balance between them.

A mix is a sum, so scaling every layer of it scales the sum: the balance the person set
stays where they put it. Moving only the tracks caught over would change that balance and
would not even guarantee the sum fits — two tracks at two-thirds each are over without
either being over alone. A number that brings nothing down refuses rather than quietly
doing nothing.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.check_mi.description:
Asks this device to measure the cut's whole mix, and keeps where it went over full scale so
the flag, the way to each place and the trim know what they are talking about.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.hear_mix.description:
Takes what a live play has heard so far: the mix clipping is heard as the cut plays, and the
flag and its way there stand from the first place it went over.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.forgot_m.description:
Forgets a measurement of a mix that has been changed since: what was measured describes a
sum that no longer exists.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.redraw.A.description:
Draws the frame the preview last showed again, so an edit made after it is seen at once. A
cut whose frame the window never showed draws nothing: there is no place to draw it at.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.sample_k.description: Takes the colour of the cut's frame where the person pointed, as the key that removes it.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.filmstri.description: Draws eight frames of the clip across its own part, kept until a trim asks for them again.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.draw_nex.description: Draws the filmstrip of the first clip whose frames are missing or stale.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.add_titl.description: Adds a title to the bin and places it at `at`.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.adopt_fo.description:
Takes the cut's shape from a source: the frame size and rate it was shot at, so the cut is
shown as the source is. The button that does it names the source, so pressing it is never a
guess about which of several sources it meant.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.link_cli.description: Makes two clips one shot's picture and sound: they move and cut together.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.split_au.description: Moves a picture clip's own sound onto an audio clip of its own, linked to it.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.delete_m.description: Takes a source out of the bin, and every clip that showed it with it.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.preview..description: Draws the frame the preview shows at `at`.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.play_cut.description:
Plays the cut from `at`: the device composites each frame as the playhead reaches it and
mixes the sound for the same moment, so the window shows the cut itself rather than a render
of it. A negative rate plays the footage and its sound backwards.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.stop_cut.description: Stops the live play: the device stops compositing and the sound stops with the picture.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.pause_cu.description: Stops the live play where it stands, and draws that frame: what pause does.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.shuttle..description:
One press of a shuttle control: the same way doubles the speed up to sixteen times, the
other way starts again at normal speed that way.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.jump_to..description: Stops the live play and draws the frame `at` in its place: what a jump or a frame step does.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.live_at..description: Where the live play has the playhead now, or -1 when nothing plays.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.scrub_to.description:
Scrubs to the second `at`: the live play stops, the frame under the playhead is drawn,
and a short piece of the sound there is played. A drag runs this at every move.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.play_mov.description:
Whether the live play is still running: a word of nowhere means it is just starting, and a
word at either end means it has stopped there.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.refresh_.description:
Hands the device the cut as it now is: an edit made while the cut plays is seen as it is
made, rather than at the next play.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.hear_scr.description:
The cut's sound where the playhead was dragged: a short snippet, not the timeline's running
sound.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.export_c.description:
Renders the cut to a file, refusing when a source this device cannot read would leave the
film missing its footage.

tl.so.tilo.video-editor.Project.poll_ren.description: Asks how far the running render has got.

tl.so.tilo.lang.views.Views.discard.Argu.description: Throws a view away, and with it how a type showed through it.

the log recorded them, never who adds it: what it does asks first unless the person trusts
that sender. It is a copy: a later change the sender makes to theirs does not reach it.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.save_place..description:
Saves a place a person follows. A place near one already saved is that place, not a second
entry, and a new place is the one windows show first.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.use_as_defa.description: Shows a place's forecast first whenever the app opens.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.move_to_top.description: Moves a place to the top of the list.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.rename_plac.description: Renames a place the person follows.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.remove_plac.description: Removes a place from the list; what was read of it goes with it. Undo brings it back.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.refresh.Arg.description:
Reads the forecasts again: every place, or the one `place` names. The window reads a few
places each second (`poll_weather`), so a slow service costs one place at a time and each
forecast lands as it is read.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.stop_refres.description: Stops an update that is running; the places it had not read keep what they had.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.retry_place.description: Updates a place whose last read failed, once the person asks again.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.read_next.A.description: Reads one place an update has still to read, and says when the update has read them all.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.poll_weathe.description:
Takes what the last read found: a place's reading and its hours and days land together, and
the search's rows beside the field. What an update reads is nobody's step of their own, so
landing it says nothing and offers no undo of its own. A second read of the same place
replaces the first.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.begin_searc.description: Looks for places by name: the window asks the service once per query as it is typed.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.end_search..description: Empties the field and stops looking.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.add_found.A.description: Saves the place a search found, by its place in the list of what it found, and shows it.

tl.so.tilo.weather.Locations.accept_foun.description: Takes the row a person picked from the search: saves the place and empties the search.

Reads one place's forecast and air quality. One failing leaves the other's answer standing,
and a place the service did not answer keeps what it had and says why.

block.description: The paragraph's address, `tl:<app>:<id>#<field>.<place>`, as block search names one; the text's fields: body

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.inser.description: Put a paragraph before the one the address names.

block.description: The paragraph's address, `tl:<app>:<id>#<field>.<place>`, as block search names one; the text's fields: body

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.delet.description: Remove the paragraph the address names, and the paragraphs it holds.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.new_d.description:
Starts the document over: a blank page, or the Markdown one of the templates starts with.
A document that holds words is replaced all the same — the change is one the person takes
back, as every change is, and the templates are named in the File menu beside New.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.dismi.description: Takes away the reason the page shows over the writing: the person read it.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.appen.description: Adds a paragraph of `text` at the end of the document, as Markdown says it.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.repla.description:
Replaces the whole body from Markdown: headings, lists, pipe tables, emphasis and links. A
picture is not written into the Markdown; it is placed with `place_image`.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.read_.description: What the document says as Markdown, ready for an agent or a file.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.repla.description:
Finds `find` in the document and replaces the first of it, or every one, with `replace`. The
words are replaced where they stand, as the editor replaces them: a paragraph's marks, its
formatting and the comments anchored in it stay around the words that stay.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.inser.description: Inserts an empty table of `rows` by `columns` where the writing ends, its head the first row.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.add_r.description:
Adds a blank row to a table of the document, under the row `row` counted from its head at 1,
or under its last row. Only that table changes, as a row added in the editor's grid does.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.add_c.description:
Adds a blank column to a table of the document, right of the column `column` counted from its
left at 1, or right of its last.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.delet.description: Deletes a row of a table of the document, counted from its head at 1.
Deletes a column of a table of the document, counted from its left at 1.
Deletes a table of the document and everything it holds; the words around it stay.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.write.description:
Writes `text` in one cell of a table of the document, at `row` counted from its head at 1 and
`column` from its left at 1: that cell's words change and nothing else does, as typing in the
editor's grid changes them.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.set_s.description:
Changes how the named style `style` looks: its face (sans, serif or mono), its size in points,
whether it is bold or italic, its colour (#rrggbb), how its lines align (left, center, right,
justify), and the space before and after it and its indent, in points. What is left out stays
as it was. The style is the document's own, so every paragraph set in it changes at once, on
every device, and the change is one a person takes back.

Sets the ink of the named style `style` to one of the inks the page offers, counted from 0 in
the order its colour swatches show them: the page's black and greys, then blue, green, ochre,
red, violet and pink.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.new_s.description:
Makes a new named style called `name`, looking as the style `from` does: a person sets
paragraphs in it and changes its look without touching the styles every document has.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.dupli.description: Makes a copy of the named style `style`, called "`style` copy", to change apart from it.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.delet.description:
Deletes a style the document made: its paragraphs go back to the body's look. The styles
every document has (Body, the headings, Quote and List item) stay.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.set_p.description: Sets the page's margins, in points from the page's edges.
Sets the paper the page is written on: A4, Letter or Legal.

Sets the words every page's top or bottom margin carries: `where` is `header` or `footer`.
Empty words for the header leave the document's title there.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.gener.description:
Writes a table of contents at the head of the document. It is a field, not a copy: the page
draws the document's headings into it as they stand, so an entry a person writes or takes
away shows there at once. A document without headings is refused: there is nothing to list.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.set_h.description: Gives the document's words a link at the end of it, reading `text` or the address itself.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.inser.description: Insert a page break at the end of the writing.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.paste.description: Puts `markdown` at the end of the writing, as a paste does.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.repla.description: Replaces the whole body with `text`, as Markdown.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.place.description:
Writes a picture in where the person is writing: the person picks the file, and the page
hands the address of its content to the editor, which puts it at the caret. The document
keeps the address rather than the picture.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.share.description: The first picture the document shows, as content another app can take.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.delet.description: Deletes the picture whose address is `image`.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.react.description:
Adds your reaction with an emoji to the document, or takes it back when you had reacted with
it: a press on one of the pills in the bar, or the pick the add button opened.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.comme.description:
Says something about the document, in the thread beside its page. When `at` names a
paragraph and `start..end` cover words in it, the remark is anchored there: the editor marks
the words and stands the comment's marker in the margin beside them, so it always points at
what it was made about. The comment and its anchor are one change.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.open_.description:
Opens a file into the document: a Word, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB or HTML file read by the
device's codecs as the Markdown the editor shows, Markdown as it stands, and plain text as
one paragraph a line. A file no codec here reads is refused with what it is. Opening a file
is one change, which the person takes back as any other.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.expor.description: The document as a Markdown file, named by its title.
The document as a plain-text file: its words, a paragraph a line.

The document as a Word, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB or PDF file, named by its title: what a
person sends someone who does not write in Tilo. The bytes are the device's codecs'.
The document as one HTML page: its headings, lists and paragraphs, and its words.

tl.so.tilo.word-processor.Document.read_.description:
Reads a file and answers what it says, without touching the document: what an agent reads a
document through before it decides what to do with it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Names this attempt: a retry with the same key answers what the first did and runs nothing twice

Invocation.name: Tilo-Invocation
Invocation.description: The invocation this call is a step of: every call naming it is one undo step per app

ContentRange.name: Content-Range
ContentRange.description: `bytes <from>-<to>/<size>`: where this piece of a file starts and ends, and how big the whole file is. Omitted when the whole file is one request.
